tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa'i rnam bshad bzhugs/

gnyis pa de nyid nges par byed pa'i tshul la/ shes bya sdug bsngal gyi bden pa gtan la dbab pa/ spang bya kun 'byung gi bden pa gtan la dbab pa/ thob bya 'gog lam gyi bden pa gtan la dbab pa gsum/ dang po la/ nang bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag dang*/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po la/ dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ rten 'brel bye brag tu bshad pa/ skye ba gnas pa'i thabs/ gnas pa 'chi ba'i 'pho sems/ sems kyi tshogs gsum du sdud pa lnga/ dang po la/ khams gsum du dbye ba/ 'gro ba rigs lngar dbye ba/ skye gnas bzhir dbye ba gsum/ dang po la/ 'dod khams/ gzugs khams/ gzugs med khams bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*/ /mi rnams dang ni lha drug dag /'dod pa'i khams yin dmyal ba dang*/ /gling dbye ba las de nyi shu/ zhes byung*/ dmyal ba dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro dang mi rnams dang*/ 'dod lha rigs drug dag dang bcas pa'i brten pa dang rten rlung dkyil yan chad kyi snod dang bcas pa chos can/ 'dod pa'i khams yin te/ 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i sas bsdus shing de la chags bral ma byas pa'i khams dngos dang sder gtogs gang rung yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i 'gro ba chos can/ khyod la rigs kyi dbye na lnga yod de/ dmyal ba nas 'dod lha rigs drug gi bar lnga yod pa'i phyir/ de rnams kyi sgra don yod de/ bsod nams ma yin pa'i las kyis yid du mi 'ong zhing sdug bsngar gyis gzir bar byed pas na dmyal ba/ bkres skom gyis gdung bas zas skom yid la btags pas na yi dwags/ dud de 'gro bas na dud 'gro/ yid shas che bas na mi/ nam mkhar rtse zhing rol bas na lha zhes bya ba'i phyir/ 'dod lha rigs drug gi sgra don yod de/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i gnas der skyes pa'i lha yin pas na rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i lha/ de bzhin du nye dbang so gnyis dang dbang po brgya byin dang bcas pa'i so gsum gyi gnas la sum cu rtsa gsum/

lha min dang 'thab rtsod bral ba'i gnas yin pas na 'thab bral/ dga' ba mang po 'byung ba'i gnas yin pas na dga' ldan/ rang gis sprul pa'i longs spyod la dbang bsgyur bas na 'phrul dga'/ gzhan gyis sprul pa'i longs spyod la'ang dbang bsgyur bas na gzhan 'phrul dbang byed ces brjod pa yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod khams de chos can/ khyod la gnas rigs nyi shur dbyer yod de/ tsha dmyal brgyad dang yi dwags dang dud 'gro'i gnas dang bcas ngan 'gro'i gnas bcu dang*/ gling bzhi'i mi'i gnas dang 'dod lha rigs drug gi gnas bcas bde 'gro'i gnas bcu yod pa'i phyir/ dbye ba de dag ni gnas sam gang zag re re kho na la sbyor ba min te/ de gnyis ka la sbyor ba'i dbang du mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'dir grang dmyal dang nye tshe ba dang gling phran rnams so sor logs su mi 'byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ grang dmyal brgyad ni tsha dmyal so so'i 'khor yin zhing*/ nye tshe ba ni yul dang gungs dang tshang ma nges pa dang*/ gling phran rnams ni gling bzhi so so'i 'khor yin pa'i rgyu mtshan gyis logs su ma bshad par bsdus nas bstan pa'i phyir/ gling bcu gnyis na mi yod kyang der ma nges te/ rnga yab gling na srin po du ma gnas pa'i phyir/ gling phran gyi mi rnams ni rang gi rtsa ba'i gling gi mi'i lus las lus chung ste/ gang spel las/ de la gnas pa'i mi rnams ni lus chung ba yin no/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gong ma'i gnas dag bcu bdun ni/ gzugs khams yin der so so yi/ /bsam gtan sa ni gsum pa yin/ /bzhi pa sa ni brgyad pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ khams gong ma'i gnas tshangs ris nas 'og min gyi bar dag bcu bdun gyi rten sa dang gang zag rnams chos can/ gzugs kyi khams yin te/ las kyis 'phangs pa ltar 'dod pa la chags pa dang bral zhing*/ gzugs la chags bral ma byas pas rab tu phye ba'i sas bsdus pa yin pa'i phyir/

gzugs khams der ni chos can/ khyod la so so'i dbye ba bcu bdun yod de/ bsam gtan gyis dang po gsum la ni gsum gsum dang bzhi pa'i sa la ni brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ bsam gtan dang po la tshangs ris tshangs pa 'dun 'don tshangs chen gsum/ gnyis pa la 'od chung tshad med 'od 'od gsal gsum/ gsum pa la dge chung tshad med dge dge rgyas gsum dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ sprin med bsod nams skye 'bras bu che ba ste so skye'i gnas gsum dang*/ mi che ba mi gdung ba shin tu mthong ba gya nom snang ba 'og min te 'phags pa'i gnas lnga yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/gzugs khams pa'i rten can yin na/ lha yin pas khyab zer na/ gzugs khams pa'i bar srid pa chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de'i bar srid kyi rten can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na de mi 'thad par thal/ bar do ba de 'gro ba rigs drug gang rung du mi gtogs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsa bar/ sems can zhes bya bar srid min/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cigabar do ba de 'gro ba ma yin zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/bar do ba de sems can yang ma yin te/ sems can zhes bya bar srid min/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ de rigs lnga'am drug po gang rung du gtogs pa'i sems can min zhes pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs med khams na gzugs med do/ /skye ba las ni rnam pa bzhi/ /der ni ris dang srog la yang*/ /sems kyi rgyud ni rten pa yin/ shes byung*/ gzugs med khams chos can/ khyod na gzugs can gyi gnas med de/ rten snod dang brten pa sems can la ni kha dog dang dbyibs sogs med pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la snyoms 'jug gi sgo nas skye ba las ni rnam pa bzhi yod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas dang de bzhin du rnam shes dang ci yang med dang 'du shes med min gyi skye mched mu bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

de chos can/ khyod la rten gzugs med kyang brten pa sems can med pa'i skyon du mi 'gyur te/ gnas der ni ris 'dra skal mnyam dang*/ der ma zad srog la yang sems kyi rgyud ni brten pa yin pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ grangs dang*/ dogs dpyod dang bcas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ der ni dmyal sogs 'gro ba lnga/ rang gi ming gis bstan de dag /nyon mongs can min lung bstan min/ /sems can zhes bya bar srid min/ /zhes byung*/ khams gsum po der ni chos can/ skye ba'i 'gro ba lnga yod de/ dmyal ba sogs te yi dwags dud 'gro mi lha'i 'gro ba lnga rang gi ming gis bstan pa de dag yod pa'i phyir/ 'dir 'gro ba la lngar bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'phen byed dge bas 'phangs pa'i lha min lha dang*/ mi dge bas 'phangs pa'i lha min yi dwags dang dud 'gror bsdus nas bstan pa'i lugs su mdzad pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba lnga chos can/ ma bsgrib lung ma bstan yin te/ de dang nyon mongs can dang lung du bstan pa gsum po gang rung gang zhig /phyi ma gnyis gang rung ma yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sems can zhes bya ste/ zag bcas kyi sems rgyud la brten pa can yin pa'i phyir/ srid pa bar ma chos can/ 'gro ba lnga po gang rung du gtogs pa min te/ de dag gis ma bsdus pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gdags pa las/ 'gro ba lngas skyes gnas bzhi ma bsdus te/ gang zhe na srid pa bar ma'o/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cig/gzhung 'di'i dngos bstan gyi 'gro ba yin na/ dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang zhes pa'i dngos bstan gyi 'gro ba yin pas khyab zer na/ grang dmyal brgyad kyi 'gro ba rnams chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ dmyal sogs zhes pas dngos su bstan pa'i 'gro ba yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ ma yin par thal/ gzhung des de brgyad tsha dmyal brgyad ston pa'i shugs kyis bstan pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ des grang dmyal dang nye tshe ba gnyis ka shugs la bstan pa'i phyir/

ma grub na/ dngos bstan la de nyi shu zhes pa mi 'thad par thal/ nyi shu las grangs mang ba'i grang dmyal sogs yod pa'i phyir/ 'o na gza' dang rgyu skar dri za gshin rje sogs 'gro ba drug po gang du gtogs zhe na/ yod de/ gza' dang rgyu skar dri za rnams lhar gtogs/ nam mkha' lding dang mi'am ci dang klu rnams dud 'gror gtogs/ 'byung po sha za srin po smyo byed brjed byed gshin rje ma mo sogs phal cher yi dwags su gtogs shing*/ da lta gzhi bdag tu grags pa 'di rnams kyang yi dwags su gtogs pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sems kyi gnas pa bdun bshad pa/ sems can la gnas dgu bshad pa la sems kyi gnas pa bzhi bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ lus dang 'du shes tha dad dang*/ /lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig /bzlog dang lus dang 'du shes gcig /gzugs can ma y-in gsum po dag /rnam shes gnas pa bdun lhag ma/ /de 'joms pa dang ldan zhes byung*/ /rnam shes kyi gnas pa chos can/ khyod la bdun yod de/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad pa dang lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa dang*/ de las bzlog pa lus nyid gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa dang*/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka gcig pa dang*/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i gnas dang po gsum po dag dang bdun yod pa'i phyir/ lus dang 'du shes gnyis ka tha dad pa med de/ thog mar byung ba ma yin pa'i 'dod pa'i lha mi gnyis dang*/ de 'dra ba'i bsam gtan dang po ba gsum de yin te/ de gsum lus che chung dang kha dog dang dbyibs tha dad cing*/ 'du shes bde sdug sogs kyang tha dad pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan dang por thog mar skyes ma thag pa rnams chos can/ lus tha dad cing 'du shes gcig pa zhes bya ste/ lus snga ma dang 'dra zhing*/ 'du shes tshangs chen gyis byas so snyam par gcig pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gnyis pa ba rnams chos can/ lus gcig cing 'du shes tha dad pa yin te/ lus 'od lus su gcig pa gang zhig

/'du shes bde ba dang btang snyoms gnyis re mos su don du gnyer ba'i phyir/ bsam gtan gsum pa chos can/ lus gcig cing 'du shes kyang rigs gcig pa yin te/ lus sngar ltar dang*/ 'du shes tshor ba bde bar rigs gcig pa'i phyir/ de'i lhag ma ngan song gsum dang bsam gtan bzhi pa dang srid rtse rnams chos can/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa zhes mi bya ste/ rnam shes de 'joms byed dang ldan pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ngan song gsum na sdug bsngal gyis 'joms/ bsam gtan bzhi par 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug gis 'joms/ srid rtser 'gog snyoms kyis 'joms pa'i phyir/ mi dang 'dod lha dang bsam gtan dang por phyis skyes pa'i lha gang rung yin na/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa dang po yin pas ma khyab ste/ 'gog snyoms rgyud ldan gyi de dag yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ srid rtse dang*/ 'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams/ / sems can gyi ni gnas dgur bshad/ /mi 'dod bzhin gnas phyir gzhan min/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sems can gyi ni gnas dgur bshad du yod de/ sngar gyi gnas pa bdun dang srid rtse dang 'du shes med pa'i sems can rnams dang dgu yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'di dag tu sems can de rnams rang dgar gnas par byed pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan ngan song gsum po chos can/ sems kyi gnas su 'dod pa ma yin te/ gnas der mi 'dod bzhin du gnas pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gnas pa dag ni yang bzhi ste/ /zag dang bcas pa'i phung po bzhi/ /rang gi sa pa nyid rnam shes/ /'ba' zhig gnas par ma bshad do/ /bsdu na mu ni bzhi yin no/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa dag ni bdun du ma 'dus pa yang bzhi ste/ zag pa dang bcas pa'i gzugs tshor 'du shes 'du byed kyi phung po bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ zag bcas de dag rang gi sa pa nyid yin pa zhig dgos te/ sa gzhan gyi phung po la sa gzhan gyi rnam shes dga' ba'i sred pa mi skye ba'i phyir/

der thal/ 'og ma'i phung po lta bu rang sa'i rnam shes kho na'i gnas yin pa'i phyir/ 'dir rnam shes 'ba' zhig gnas par ma bshad de/ rnam shes ni rnam shes kyi gnas ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rang nyid rang la rten pa 'gal ba'i phyir/ rnam shes kyi gnas pa chos can/ khyod la bsdu na mu ni bzhi yod pa yin te/ bdun gyis bsdus la bzhis ma bsdus pa dang*/ de las bzlog pa dang*/ gnyis kas bsdus pa dang*/ gnyis kas ma bsdus pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi zag bcas ky-i rnam par shes pa'i phung po lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ ngan song gsum dang bsam gtan bzhi dang srid rtse'i rnam shes ma gtogs pa'i phung po bzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ bdun gyi gnas skabs kyi zag bcas kyi phung po dang po bzhi lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa yod de/ ngan song ba dang bsam gtan bzhi pa dang srid rtsi'i rnam shes lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa skye gnas bzhir dbye ba la/ gang du 'jug pa skye gnas kyi dbye ba/ gang 'jug pa bar srid kyi rang bzhin/ de skye gnas su 'jug tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ der ni sgo nga las skyes sogs/ /sems can skye gnas bzhi dag tu/ /mi dang dud 'gro rnam pa bzhi/ dmyal ba pa dang lha rnams dang*/ /srid pa bar ma brdzus te skye/ /yi dwags mngal nas skye ba'ang yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'gro ba sems can rnams chos can/ khyod la khams gsum po der ni skye gnas bzhi dag tu yod de/ sgo nga las skyes pa dang sogs te mngal skyes drod gsher skyes rdzus skyes rnams yod pa'i phyir/ mi dang dud 'gro chos can/ khyod la skye gnas rnam pa bzhi ga yod de/ mi la de bzhi yod pa gang zhig /dud 'gro la'ang de bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ mi sgong skyes ni gru zhig pa'i tshong pa bya khrung khrung mo dang 'dus pa'i sgong skyes dge slong grags pa dang nye ba'i grags pa gnyis/

ri dwags 'dzin gyi bu sgong skyes sum cu rtsa gnyis/ rgyal po lnga len gyi bu lnga brgya lta bu dang*/ mi mngal skyes sla zhing*/ drod gsher skyes ni rgyal po gso sbyong 'phags kyi spyi bo las nga las nu dang brla g.yas g.yon las mdzes pa dang nye mdzes skyes pa lta bu dang*/ rdzus skyes ni bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ dud 'gro klu dang nam mkha' lding la de bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ nam mkha' lding rdzus skyes kyis klu de bzhi ga za/ drod gsher gyis de gsum za/ mngal skyes kyis de gnyis za/ sgong skyes kyis klu sgong skyes kho na za bar bshad pa'i phyir/ rdzus skyes la ro med par bshad pa dang mi 'gal te/ ma shi'i bar du za ba yin pa'i phyir/ dmyal ba pa dang lha rnams dang srid pa bar ma chos can/ skye gnas gcig par nges te/ brdzus te skye ba kho na yin pa'i phyir/ yi dwags chos can/ khyod la brdzus te skye ba mang yang der ma nges te/ mngal nas skye ba'ang yod pa'i phyir/ skye gnas bzhi'i mchog dman yod de/ rdzus skyes mchog drod skyes dang mngal skyes 'bring*/ sgong skyes tha ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ snga ma gnyis gzhan la gnod med du skye zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis gzhan la gnod cing rang gzhan sdug bsngal myong ba dang bcas par skye ba'i phyir/ 'on kyang ston pa chos can/ snga ma gnyis bzhag nas mngal du skye ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ gdul bya spro ba bskyed cing chos la 'god pa dang mu stegs byed sogs kyis sgyu ma mkhan no snyam pa'i log rtog sel ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ skye gnas bzhi las gang mang zhe na/ bshad tshe da ltar na rdzus skyes mang ste/ lha thams cad dang dmyal ba pa rnams dang bar do ba thams cad kyang rdzus skyes yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa bar srid la/ ngo bo/ sgrub byed/ khyad chos gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dir gang 'chi dang skye ba yi/

/srid pa'i bar du 'byung ba'o/ /bgrod pa'i yul du ma phyin phyir/ /srid pa bar ma byung ba min/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bar srid chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ 'jig rten 'dir gang gi snga ma'i 'chi ba dang phyi ma'i skye ba'i srid pa'i bar du 'byung ba'i srid pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ srid pa bar ma chos can/ khyod skyes kyang byung ba zhes pa'i tha snyad byed pa min te/ byung ba ni bgrod pa'i yul du son zin pa la byed pas/ khyod gang du bgrod pa'i yul du son ma zin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sngon dus kyi srid bar ma phyin pa'i phyir gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/bar do ba yin na/ bar srid rgyud ldan yin pas khyab zer na/ gzugs kyi bar srid kyi rten la myang 'das thob pa'i bar do ba chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ de yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ phyir mi 'ong bar 'dar ba yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ mi 'thad par thal/ srid pa cha shas bral gyi tshul gyis spangs pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de mi 'thad par thal/ skye srid kyi rten can yin na/ de rgyud ldan yin mi dgos pa'i phyir/ der thal/ gzugs kyi skye srid kyi rten la myang 'das mngon du byed pa'i nyan thos yod pa'i phyir/ kha cigaskye srid du nying 'tshams sbyor ba'i blo yin na/ blo phyin ci log yin pas khyab zer na/ rgyal po gzhon nu don grub tu nying mtshams sbyor ba'i blo chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ 'dod mi nus te/ bsam bzhin ma 'khrul bar 'jug pa'i blo yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/yum sgyu ma lha mdzes kyi mngal du 'jug kha ma'i bar do ba de mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs kyis spras par thal/ ston pa des spras pa gang zhig /sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod na/ sangs rgyas yin par thal lo/ kha cig/mi ldog de ni dri

za'o/ /zhes gsungs pa mi 'thad par thal/ khyi'i bar srid grub nas mir skye ba yod pa'i phyir zer na/ ma khyab ste/ gtso che ba la dgongs pa'i phyir/ rtags der thal/ kun btus las/ ci sten ldog go /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ kha cigakhyi'i bar srid grub nas dud 'gro gzhan du skye ba med zer na/ de yod par thal/ de grub nas dom lta bu lce spyang du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rkyen ma tshang ba'i dbang gis der 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khrig pa'i dus dang 'gro ba rigs mthun pa'i dbang gis de ltar du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der thal/ dgun ba lang gi bar srid grub kyang ba lang de dbyar chags pa spyod cing*/ ba men dus min du spyod pas ba men du skye/ dgun rta'i bar srid grub na de sos ka chags pa spyod cing*/ bong bu dus min du spyod pas bong bur skye/ dbyar dom gyi bar srid grub na de dgun chags pa spyod cing*/ dred dus min du spyod pas dred du skye/ dbyar khyi'i bar srid grub na de ston chags pa spyod cing*/ lce spyang dus min du spyod pas ce spyang du skye ba yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /mi khyi'i bar srid pa rnams mi khyi yin zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ de dag 'gal ba'i phyir/ der thal/ bar srid pa rnams rdzus skyes yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig /bar srid pa yin na/ rang gi sngon dus kyi srid pa dang dbang po sogs rnam pa thams cad du 'dra bas khyab zer na/ mi 'thad par thal/ dbang po ma tshang ba'i mi'i bar do ba rnams dbang po kun tshang ba'i phyir/ der thal/ dbang po kun tshang zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ der ma zad/ 'bu srin phra mo'i bar do ba rnams ni ji ltar yin dpyad dgos pa yod do/ /gnyis pa sgrub byed la/ rigs pa dang*/ lung gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'bru yi rgyun dang chos mthun phyir/ srid pa chad las byung ba min/ /gzugs brnyan ma grub phyir ba dang*/ /mi 'dra'i phyir na dpe ma yin/

/gcig na lhan cig gnyis med phyir/ /rgyun min phyir gnyis las byung phyir/ zhes byung*/ phal chen sde pa dang sa ston sde pa na re/ bar srid med de/ skye srid dang 'chi srid bar ma chad par 'byung ba'i phyir zer na/ de ni mi 'thad de/ skye srid kyi gzugs sems gnyis ni rang gi rgyun sngon ma'i bar srid kyi gzugs sems sngon du song ba la brten nas byung ba'i phyir te/ dper na 'bru shar nas nub tu drangs pa'i tshe rgyun phyi ma 'byung ba dang chos mthun pa bzhin/ bar srid med par 'chi ba'i srid pa rgyun chad pa las skye srid kyi gzugs sems gnyis byung ba min no/ /de la kho na re/ 'chi srid rgyun chad pa las skye srid 'byung ba'i dpe yang yod de/ me long gi ngos sogs dang byad bzhin gyi gzugs kyi bar 'gyangs chen po yod kyang*/ de dag tu gzugs brnyan 'byung ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir zer na/ dpe don de ma yin par thal/ khyod 'dod pa ltar de'i dpe la ma grub cing*/ grub tu chug kyang dpe don mi 'dra ba'i phyir/ dang po der thal/ khyod kyis gzugs brnyan kha dog can gyi thogs bcas su 'dod kyang de ltar ma grub pa'i phyir/ der thal/ der me long gi ngos dang gzugs brnyan snang yang de lta bu'i kha dog tha dad pa gnyis go sa gcig na lhan cig med pa'i phyir te/ der de lta bu'i 'byung ba rigs tha dad pa gnyis cig car du med pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mi'i lus kyi 'byung ba dang mkhar ba'i 'byung ba gnyis 'gal ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa der thal/ byad bzhin gyi gzugs brnyan de byad bzhin gyi rgyun ma yin pas mi 'dra ba'i phyir dang*/ me long gi gzugs brnyan de byad bzhin dang me long gi ngos tshogs pa gnyis las byung ba ltar/ skye srid ni de 'dra'i rgyun gnyis las mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ sbyor ba 'god tshul gcig la/ 'chi srid kyi sems chos can/ rgyun mi chad par yul gzhan du 'byung ste/

rgyun gyis yul gzhan du skye zhing 'jug pa'i chos yin pa'i phyir/ dper na 'bru yul gzhan du drangs pa'i rgyun bzhin zhes pa'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ mgur nas gsungs phyir yod dri za/ /lngar gsungs 'gro mdo las kyang grub/ /zhes byung*/ dri za bar srid chos can/ khyod yod de/ ston pa'i mgur nas srid pa ni bdun te/ dmyal ba'i srid pa dang*/ yi dwags kyi srid pa dang*/ dud 'gro'i srid pa dang*/ mi'i srid pa dang*/ lha'i srid pa dang*/ las kyi srid pa dang*/ srid pa bar ma'o zhes 'gro ba bdun gsungs pa'i mdo'i khungs las kyang grub pa'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang bar 'da' ba gcig /skye 'da' ba gsum/ gong 'pho ba dang lngar gsungs pas kyang khyod yod par grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de ni 'phen pa gcig pa'i phyir/ /sngon dus srid 'byung sha tshugs can/ /de ni 'chi ba'i sngon rol te/ /skye ba'i skad cig phan chad do/ /ris mthun lha mig dag pas mthong*/ /las kyi rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan/ /dbang po kun tshang thogs med ldan/ /mi ldog de ni dri za'o/ /zhes byung*/ lha mi'i bar srid pa de chos can/ khyod kyi byad dbyibs yod de/ rang gang du skyes 'gyur gyi lha mi'i sngon dus kyi srid pa 'byung ba de'i sha tshugs can du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de ltar 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ khyod dang rang gi sngon dus kyi srid pa de gnyis 'phen byed kyi las gcig gis 'phangs pa'i phyir/ sngon dus kyi srid pa la de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ skye srid kyi rjes yin yang 'chi srid kyi sngon yin pas de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ sngon dus kyi srid pa de ni chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ skye srid grub pa'i skad cig gnyis pa phan chad nas 'chi ba'i srid pa'i sngon rol tshun chad la 'jog pa'i phyir/ bar srid pa chos can/ mi phal pa rnams dang ris mi mthun pas mi mthong ste/

lha'i bar do bas lha'i bar do ba dang mi'i bar do bas mi'i bar do ba lta bu phan tshun ris mthun pas gcig gis gcig mthong zhing*/ ris mi mthun pas mi mthong la/ 'on kyang gong ma'i bar do bas 'og ma'i bar do ba mthong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bar do ba chos can/ khyod gzhan gyis mthong ba yod de/ skyon bcu gcig dang bral ba'i mngon shes dang lha'i mig gi rnam par dag pas mthong ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ rdzu 'phrul dang ldan pa yin te/ nam mkha' ba 'gro nus pa'i las stobs kyis thob pa'i rdzu'aphrul dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ shugs dang ldan te/ gang 'dod pa'i sar skad cig gis sleb nus pa'i las kyi shugs myur ba dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ dbang po kun tshang ba yin te/ dbang po lnga tshang ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ thogs pa med pa dang ldan te/ ri brag sogs la'ang thogs rdugs med par 'gro ba'i phyir/ bye brag smra ba'i lugs 'dir gang gi bar srid grub pa de'i sngon dus kyi srid pa 'grub par nges te/ bar srid de grub nas 'gro ba rigs mi mthun pa gzhan du mi ldog pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyis kham zas kyang za ste/ dri za bar byed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi kha dog gi khyad par yod de/ dmyal ba'i bar do ni sdong dum mes tshig pa lta bu sogs yin pa'i phyir/ bong tshod yod de/ lha mi'i bar do ba de byis pa lo lnga'am drug lon pa lta bur yod pa'i phyir/ gos dang bcas ma bcas gnyis yod de/ ngo tsha khrel yod che ba rnams gos dang bcas shing*/ ngo tsha dang khrel med rnams gcer bur skye ba shas che ba'i phyir/ tshe tshad yod de/ zhag bdun re gnas te/ skye ba'i rkyen tshogs na shi nas gzhan du nying mtshams sbyor la/ ma rnyed na slar bar dor skye la/ bdun phrag bdun tshun chad du der 'dug srid kyi/ de phan chad du mi gnas pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa skye gnas su bgrod pa'i tshul la/

dngos dang*/ dbye ba gnyis pa dang po ni/ blo ni phyin ci log gyur pas/ /rtse dgas 'gro ba'i yul du 'gro/ / dri dang gnas la mngon 'dod gzhan/ /dmyal ba yi ni spyi tshugs yin/ /zhes byung*/ mnga' sgo nga las skye ba'i bar do ba chos can/ khyod skye gnas su bgrod tshul yod de/ rgyang ring po nas kyang las kyi dbang gis skye gnas mthong ba ngang gi blo ni phyin ci log tu gyur nas chags pas rtse zhing*/ dga' bas 'gro ba'i yul skye gnas der 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan drod dang sgong skyes chos can/ skye gnas su 'jug tshul yod de/ snga ma dri dang*/ phyi ma gnas la mngon par 'dod pa'i rkyen gyis 'jug pa'i phyir/ gnas 'dod nas 'jug tshul yod de/ lha lta bus gnas yid du 'ong ba dang*/ tsha dmyal du skye na dmyal ba'i me mthong nas dang*/ grang dmyal du skye na dmyal ba'i bsil mthong nas 'dod pa'i rkyen gyis de dag tu 'jug par 'gyur pa'i phyir/ bar srid kyi 'gro tshul yod de/ dmyal ba yi ni bar srid spyi bo tshugs su 'gro la/ lha'i bar do ba ni gyen dang*/ gzhan gsum ni thad kar 'gro ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gcig ni shes bzhin du 'jug go /gzhan ni gnas pa yang gzhan ni/ /'byung ba'ang gzhan ni thams cad rmongs/ /sgo nga las skyes rtag tu rmongs/ /mngal du 'jug pa gsum dag ste/ /'khor los bsgyur dang rang byung gnyis/ /las sam ye shes sam gnyis ka /rgya che'i phyir na go rim bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ mngal du 'jug pa'i tshe blo phyin ci log tu 'gyur bar ma nges te/ gcig ni shes bzhin du 'jug la gnas pa dang 'byung ba shes bzhin min pa 'khor los bsgyur rgyal dang*/ gzhan rang sangs rgyas ni 'jug par ma zad gnas pa yang shes shing*/ de las gzhan sangs rgyas ni 'jug tu ma zad 'byung ba'ang shes la/ de gsum las gzhan ni 'jug gnas 'byung gsum thams cad la rmongs shing sgo nga las skyes pa ni rtag tu rmongs pa can yin pa'i phyir/

de la shes bzhin du mngal du 'jug pa dag ni snga ma gsum 'dra yang khyad par yod de/ sngar bshad pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ 'khor los sgyur dang rang byung rang rgyas dang sangs rgyas gnyis te gsum ni go rim bzhin du las dang bsod nams rgya che ba tsam dang*/ ye shes rgya che la dang*/ tshogs gnyis ka rgya che ba'i khyad par gyis de ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa skye tshul rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin la/ dngos dang*/ zhar byung srid pa bzhi'i khyad par gnyis/ dang po la/ 'khor bar 'jug tshul gy-i sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ /grub pa'i 'khor ba rgyas par bshad pa/ nyon mongs pas dpe gsum mtshon tshul gyi sgo nas don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po la/ 'khor bar 'jug tshul dngos dang*/ srid rgyun thog med du bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bdag med phung po tsam nyid de/ /nyon mongs las kyis mngon 'du byas/ /srid pa bar ma'i rgyun gyis na/ /mar me bzhin du mngal du 'gro/ /zhes byung*/ phyi rol ba na re/ sems can 'jig rten snga ma nas 'dir 'ong ba dang*/ 'di nas phyi mar 'pho zhing 'gro ba zhig yod par thal/ skye 'chi byed pa'i bdag zhig yod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ rtag po'i bdag zhig yod par thal/ 'dod pa'i phyir/ 'dod na/ bdag med ma yin par thal lo zer na/ phyi rol ba chos can/ khyod kyis rtag pa'i bdag med na skye bo snga phyir nying 'tshams sbyor du mi rung bar 'dod pa mi 'thad par thal/ rtag pa'i bdag med kyang phung po tsam la bdag tu 'dogs pa nyid yin zhing*/ phung po'i rgyun tsam gyis skye ba snga phyir nying 'tshams sbyor bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ der thal/ skye ba sngon mar nyon mongs pas kun nas bslangs te zag bcas kyi las mngon par 'du byas pa las/ phung po'i rang bzhin can gyi srid pa bar ma'i sems kyi rgyun dang*/ de las skye srid kyi sems kyi rgyun 'byung ba nyid kyis na/ dper na/ mar me'i rgyun snga phyir gzhan du 'jug pa ltar phung po'i rgyun tsam mngal du 'gro ba sogs yin pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa ni/ ji ltar 'phangs bzhin rim gyis rgyun/ skyes nas las dang nyon mongs kyis/ /'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo thog ma med/ /ces byung*/ srid pa'i 'khor lo 'di chos can/ khyod kyi thog ma med de/ sngon ma rig pas kun nas bslangs te zag bcas kyi 'phen byed kyi las bsags/ des yang srid phyi mar yang dang yang du ji ltar 'phangs pa bzhin du so sor 'khod la/ skye ba snga mar ma rig pa dang las gzhan sngon du song ba las 'dir rim gyis phung po'i rgyun 'byung zhing*/ 'dir skyes nas kyang las dang nyon mongs pa'i stobs kyis phyi ma'i 'jig rten pha rol dag tu 'gro bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ mngal du 'jug tshul gsal bar mngal 'jug gi mdo las bshad pa'i don bdag gis gzhan du bris zin pas 'dir ma bris so/ /gnyis pa la bye brag smra ba'i lugs dang*/ mdo sde pa'i lugs gnyis/ dang po la/ rdzogs tshul/ bsdu ba/ 'khor tshul gsum/ dang po la/ mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ de ni rten cing 'brel 'byung ba'i/ /yan lag bcu gnyis cha gsum mo/ /sngon dang phyi mthar gnyis gnyis dang*/ /bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ /zhes byung*/'di la tshig don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ phung po'i rgyun skye ba'i gnas skabs gsum po de ni chos can/ khyod rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i yan lag bcu gnyis dang ldan te/ ma rig pa nas rga shi'i bar bcu gnyis dang ldan pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ sngon dang phyi mtha' bar gyi cha gsum dang ldan te/ yan lag dang po gnyis sngon gyi cha'am mtha' dang*/ skye rga gnyis ni phyi ma'i cha'am mtha' dang*/ rnam shes nas srid pa'i bar brgyad ni dbus sam bar gyi cha'am mthar 'jog pa'i phyir/ bar du brgyad yod pa yongs rdzogs ldan pa'i dbang du byas kyi/ der ma nges te/ skye gnas gzhan gsum yang yod cing*/ bar ma dor 'chi ba'ang yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la/ kha cig/yan lag bcu gnyis po de tshe gsum la nges par rdzogs dgos so zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de tshe gnyis la'ang rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ tshe sngon mar ma rig pa'i dbang gis rnam shes kyi steng du las bsags/ las de la sred len gyis gsos btab pas srid las nus pa mthu can du gyur nas phyi ma lha mi lta bur skyes pa'i tshe gzhan rnams rdzogs pa yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig/tshar gcig gi yan lag dang po gnyis tshe dang po la rdzogs/ rga shi gnyis tshe gsum pa la rdzogs/ gzhan brgyad tshe gnyis pa la rdzogs pa de tshe gsum la rdzogs pa'i don yin zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de 'dra mi srid pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rga shi gnyis ni skye ba blangs pa'i tshe de thog tu 'byung dgos pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang*/ sngon dang phyi mthar gnyis gnyis dang*/ bar du brgyad yongs rdzogs ldan la/ zhes gsungs pa dang mi 'gal te/ de ni ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis sngon dang rga shi gnyis rjes dang*/ gzhan brgyad bar du 'byung tshul spyir bstan pa tsam yin gyi/ skye ba snga phyi bar gsum gyi dbang du byas pa ma yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/cha gsum mo zhes pa'i don sngar bshad pa ltar cha gsum du byed pa tsam gyi don yin zer na/ de ma yin par thal/ de ni bcu gnyis po de la 'das ma 'ongs da lta'i dus gsum du'ang shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ yan lag dang po gnyis 'das pa dang*/ rga shi gnyis ma 'ongs pa dang*/ gzhan brgyad da lta bar shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ kha cig/ma rig pa'i rten 'brel la/ ma rig pas khyab zer na/ ma rig pa'i rten 'brel du gyur pa'i gzugs phung chos can/ der thal/ de'i phyir/ der thal/ mdo las de ltar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'dod na sla'o/ kha cig/ma rig pa'i grogs su gyur pa'i shes pa yin na/ ma rig pa yin pas khyab zer na/ ma rig pa dang mtshungs ldan du gyur pa'i tshor ba sogs chos can/

der thal/ de'i phyir/ rtags gsal sla'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ ma rig nyon mongs sngon gnas skabs/ /'du byed dag ni sngon las kyi/ rnam shes 'tshams sbyor phung po yin/ /ming dang gzugs ni de phan chad/ /skye mche drug dod tshun chad do/ /de ni gsum 'dus tshun chad do/ /rig pa bde sdug la sogs kyi/ /rgyu shes nus pa tshun chad do/ /tshor 'khrig tshun chad sred pa ni/ /longs spyod 'khrig pa chags can gyi/ /nye bar len pa longs spyod rnams/ /thob par bya phyir yongs rgyug pa'i/ /de srid 'bras bu 'byung 'gyur ba'i/ /las byed de ni srid pa yin/ /nying mtshams sbyor ba skye ba yin/ /tshor ba'i bar ni rga shi yin/ /'di ni gnas skabs bar 'dod lo/ /gtso bo'i phyir na yan lag bsgrags/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir gnas skabs pa'i ma rig pa chos can/ khyod 'jog tshul yod de/ sngon 'phen byed kyi las kun nas slong ba'i nyon mongs pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga po de de yin pa'i phyir/ 'du byed dag ni chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ sngon 'du byed kyi las gsog pa'i phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ rnam shes chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skad cig dang po'i skabs kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ ming dang gzugs ni chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rnam shes de phan chad nas skye mched drug dong tshun chad kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ skye mched de ni chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ de nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus pa tshun chad kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ reg pa chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ de nas tshor ba bde sdug la sogs kyi shes nus pa tshun chad kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ tshor ba chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rgyu shes nas 'khrig pa la mi spyod pa'i skabs tshun chad kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ sred pa chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ 'dod yon la longs spyod pa'i 'khrig pa'i chags can gyi yul yongs su 'tshol ba la zhugs pa'i phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/

nye bar len pa chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ de nas longs spyod de rnams thob par bya ba'i phyir du yongs su rgyug pa'i skabs kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ srid pa de chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ rgyug pa de srid du 'bras bu yang srid 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i las gsog par byed pa'i skabs kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ skye ba chos can/ ngo bo yod de/ 'di nas phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i skabs kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ rga shi chos can/ ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ de nas tshor ba'i bar rim gyis 'byung ba'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga de yin pa'i phyir/ de lta bu'i rten 'brel bcu gnyis po 'di chos can/ skad cig sa dang rgyun chags pa dang 'brel ba can dang gnas skabs pa bzhi las/ gnas skabs pa'i rten 'brel yin te/ 'dir yan lag de dang de'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga la rten 'brel de dang der bzhag cing 'dod pa yin pa'i phyir/ lo zhes smros pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ bye mdo gnyis kyi bshad pa la ma rangs pa'i tshig yin pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa la sogs pa'i gnas skabs kyi phung po lnga la rten 'brel de dang de'i ming gis 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ma rig pa la sogs pa de rnams gtso bo yin pa'i phyir na de'i skabs kyi yan lag de dang der bsgrags pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rgyal po 'khor bcas 'byon pa la rgyal po 'byon zhes brjod pa bzhin no/ /rten 'brel gzhan gsum gyi 'jog tshul yod de/ snga phyi rgyun dang ldan pa ni rgyu chags pa dang*/ phyi ma snga ma la rag las pa ni 'brel ba can dang*/ rkyen gyis skye 'jig byed pa ni skad cig ma'i rten 'brel du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sngon dang phyi mtha' bar dag la/ /rmongs pa rnam par bzlog phyir ro/ /zhes byung*/ rten 'brel de dag chos can/ cha gsum du bsdus nas bstan pa la dgos pa yod de/

sngon gyi mtha' dang*/ phye ma'i mtha' dang*/ bar mtha' gsum de dag la rmongs pa rnam par bzlog par bya ba'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ bdag sngon byung ngam ma byung dang*/ ma 'ongs par 'byung ngam mi 'byung dang*/da lta ci zhig yin nas min snyam pa'i rmongs pa bzlog pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rim pa bzhin ma rig pa dang 'du byed gnyis/ skye rga gnyis/ lhag ma brgyad bstan pa'i dgongs pa de ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ nyon mongs pa gsum du bsdu ba dang*/ rgyu 'bras gnyis su bsdu ba gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyon mongs gsum mo las gnyis so/ /gzhi bdun zhes byung*/ sngar bshad pa ltar yan lag bcu gnyis po chos can/ nyon mongs pa dang las dang gzhi gsum du 'du ste/ nyon mongs la ma rig pa sred len gsum/ las la 'du byed dang srid las gnyis/ gzhi ba rnam shes sogs lhag ma bdun yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin 'bras bu yin/ gnyis kyi rgyu 'bras mdor bsdus pa/ /bar ma'i rjes su dpag pa las/ /zhes byung*/ bdun gzhi yin pa de bzhin du 'bras bu yang yin te/ lhag ma lnga ni rgyu'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs gsum dang las gnyis te rgyu lnga sngon mtha' dang gzhi bdun 'bras bur bshad nas phyi mthar bsdus pa la chos can dgos pa yod de/ snga phyi'i mtha' gnyis kyis rim pa bzhin rgyu dang 'bras bu mdor bsdus pa ni/ bar ma'i rgyu 'bras rgya bskyed pa'i rjes su dpag pa las snga phyi'i rgyu 'bras kyang rgyas par go nus pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa la dngos dang*/ rgyu 'bras kyi khyad par ro/ /dang po 'khor tshul ni/ nyon mongs pa las nyon mongs dang*/ /bya ba nyid do de las gzhi/ /de las gzhi dang nyon mongs skye/ /'di ni srid pa'i yan lag lugs/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ ma rig pa la rgyu dang rga shi la 'bras bu yod pas yan lag bcu gnyis kyi grangs nges nyams pa'i skyon yod pa min te/

nyon mongs pa sred pa las nyon mongs pa len pa dang*/ de las bya ba nyid de srid pa dang ma rig pa las bya ba 'du byed dang*/ de las gzhi rnam shes dang srid pa las gzhi skye ba dang*/ de las gzhi ming gzugs sogs dang*/ gzhi skye ba las gzhi rga shi/ gzhi tshor ba las nyon mongs srid pa skye ba sogs bshad pa 'di ni srid pa'i yan lag gi lugs 'byung du ston pas bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'dir ni 'byung ba rgyu yin te/ byung ba 'bras bu yin par 'dod/ ces byung*/ de las rgyu 'bras kyi khyad par yod de/ skabs 'dir 'byung ba ni rgyu'i rten 'brel dang*/ byung ba ni 'bras bu'i rten 'brel gyi dbang du byas par 'dod pa'i phyir/ bye smra'i lugs kyi yan lag bcu gnyis la gnas skabs ma byas par bcu gnyis so sor 'jog tshul yod de/ ma rig pa ni rten 'brel la rmongs pa'i sems byung lta min gyis bsdus pa dang*/ 'du byed ni ma rig pas bskyed pa'i sgo gsum gyi las gzugs can nam de yin pa gang rung dang*/ rnam shes ni phyi mar nying mtshams sbyor ba'i rnam shes dang*/ ming gzugs ni rnam shes nying mtshams sbyar ba'i skad cig gnyis pa nas skye mched tshun chad kyi ming bzhi'i phung po dang*/ skye mched drug ni/ mig sogs kyi skye mched dngos btags gang rung dang*/ reg pa ni/ de nas yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus nas lus gcod pa'i sems byung dang*/ tshor ba ni reg pas bcad pa ltar skyong ba'i sems byung dang*/ sred pa ni/ tshor ba'i rkyen gyis yul la 'bral mi 'bral gang rung du sred pa'i sems byung dang*/ len pa ni/ sred pa'i dbang gis yul de dag la 'dun pa'i 'dod chags dang*/ srid pa ni/ len pas gsos btab nas yang srid phyi ma 'grub nges kyi las dang*/ skye ba ni/ srid las kyi dbang gis rnam shes nying mtshams sbyar ba'i phung po dang*/ rga shi'i rga ba ni skye ba'i dbang gis phung po na tshod rgas khog gi bar dang shi ba ni sems can gyi tshe 'di'i ris mthun 'dor ba'i skabs la 'jog pa'i phyir/

gnyis la mdo sde pa'i lugs la/ rten 'brel gyi rang bzhin dang*/ lhag ma 'chad pa la ltos par bstan pa gnyis/ dang po la/ ma rig pa dang ming dang reg pa dang tshor ba'i rten 'brel bzhi/ dang po ni/ rig pa'i mi mthun phyogs chos gzhan/ /ma rig mi mdza' rdzun sogs bzhin/ /kun spyod sogs tshig phyir gal te/ shes rab ngan pa'o min lta'i phyir/ /lta ba de dang mtshungs ldan phyir/ /shes rab nyon mongs bstan phyir ro/ /zhes byung*/ ma rig pa chos can/ khyod kyi mtshan nyid yod de/ rig pa ye shes dang 'dzin stangs dngos su 'gal ba'i sems byung rmongs pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ ma rig pa ni rig pa bkag tsam gyi nyon mongs la mi 'jog par/ rig pa de'i 'gal zla mi mthun phyogs su gyur pa'i chos gzhan zhig la 'jog dgos pa'i phyi dper na/ mdza' ba'i mi mthun phyogs mi mdza' ba dang*/ bden pa'i mi mthun phyogs rdzun sogs chos gzhan zhig la 'jog pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ ma rig pa zhes pa'i ma'i dgag sgra sngar bshad pa ltar 'gal zla'i chos gzhan ston pa'i dgag tshig yin par thal/ mdo las/ ma rig pa ni/ kun sbyor dang 'ching ba dang phra rgyas sogs kyi tshig gis ston pas na/ rig pa bka' tsam ni de dag tu mi rung ba'i phyir/ gal te ma rig pa ni shes rab ngan pa la 'dod pa'o zhe na/ de yang 'thad pa min te/ de lta ba yin pa'i phyir/ khyab ste/ lta ba ni ma rig pa de dang mtshungs ldan du bshad pa'i phyir dang*/ lta ba shes rab nyon mongs can dang ma rig pa gnyis nyon mongs bya mongs byed du bstan pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ming bshad pa ni/ ming ni gzugs can min phung po/ /zhes byung*/ ming gi rten 'brel chos can/ khyod kyi ngo bo yod de/ tshor 'du sogs gzugs can ma yin pa'i phung po bzhi ci rigs kyis bsdus pa zhig la byed pa'i phyir/ phung po bzhi po de ni chos can/ ming dngos min yang de ltar brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/

ming gi skad dod nā ma zhes pa gzhol ba la 'jug pas/ khyod dbang don 'bod ming gsum gyi dbang gis yul de dang de 'dzin pa la gzhol bar byed pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa reg pa ni/ reg drug 'dus te byung ba yin/ /lnga ni thogs pa'i reg pa yin/ /drug pa bla dgas tshig ces bya/ /rig dang ma rig dang gzhan rig /dri med nyon mongs can lhag ma/ /gnod sems rjes su chags pa'i reg /bde ba myong 'gyur la sogs gsum/ /zhes byung*/ reg pa'i rten 'brel chos can/ ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ yul dbang rnam shes gsum 'dus te byung zhing yul gyi 'gyur ba rang stobs kyis gcod pa'i sems byung de de yin pa'i phyir/ dbye na drug yod de/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa sogs drug yod pa'i phyir/ yid ma gtogs pa'i dang po lnga ni chos can/ thogs pa'i reg pa zhes bya ste/ thogs bcas kyi dbang po gzugs can pa la brten pa'i reg pa yin pa'i phyir/ drug pa yid kyi reg pa chos can/ tshig bla dgas kyi reg pa ces bya ste/ ming tshig sogs la dmigs pa'i yid kyi reg pa yin pa'i phyir/ reg pa chos can/ khyod la ldan gzhi'i sgo nas dbye na gsum yod de/ rig pa'i reg pa/ ma rig pa'i reg pa/ de las gzhan pa'i reg pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ dri med kyi reg pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ nyon mongs can gyi reg pa de de yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa yod de/ de gnyis kyi lhag ma dge ba zag bcas dang ma sgrib lung ma bstan gyi reg pa rnams de yin pa'i phyir/ nyon mongs can gyi reg pa chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ ma rig pa'i reg pa dang gnod sems kyi reg pa dang rjes su chags pa'i reg pa rnams yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ 'bras bu'i sgo nas gsum yod de/ bde ba myong 'gyur dang la sogs te sdug bsngal myong 'gyur dang btang snyoms myong 'gyur gyi reg pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa la/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ yid tshor bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ de las byung ba'i tshor ba drug /lnga ni las kyi'o sems kyi gzhan/ zhes byung*/ reg pa de las byung ba'i tshor ba chos can/ bdag rkyen gyis dbye na drug ste/ mig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba sogs drug yod pa'i phyir/ tshor ba dang po lnga ni chos can/ lus kyi tshor ba yin te/ bdag rkyen dbang po gzugs can pa la brten pa'i phye ba'i tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan pa tshor ba drug pa chos can/ sems kyi tshor ba yin te/ bdag rkyen sems la brten pas phye ba'i tshor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ grangs kyi sgo nas mdor bstan pa/ yul la 'jug tshul gyi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa/ ngo bo'i sgo nas don bsdu ba gsum/ dang po ni/ de yid nye bar rgyu ba las/ rnam pa dag ni yang bco brgyad/ ces byung*/ yid tshor de ni chos can/ yid yul la nye bar rgyu ba las rnam pa dag ni sngar bshad pa der ma zad/ yang bco brgyad yod de/ yul gzugs sogs drug la dmigs pa'i tshor ba yid la de drug /de lta bu'i yid mi bde ba drug /btang snyoms drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ nye bar rgyu ba'i don yod de/ yul de dag la yid nye bar rgyu bar byed pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la 'dod pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med kyi dbang du byas pa gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod na thams cad rang dmigs can/ spyod yul gzugs can bcu gnyis so/ /gong ma gsum gyi zhes byung*/ 'dod pa na chos can/ nye bar rgyu bco brgyad po thams cad yod de/ thams cad rang sa'i yul drug la dmigs pa can yin pa'i phyir/ 'dod pa'i yid kyi nyer rgyu chos can/ spyod yul yod de/ gzugs can te gzugs khams kyi yul la dmigs pa bcu gnyis dang*/ gong ma gzugs med kyi yul la dmigs pa gsum yod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ de'i dri ro la dmigs pa'i bde sdug btang snyoms drug ma gtogs pa bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/

gnyis pa grub ste/ de'i chos khams la dmigs pa'i de gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la bsam gtan dang po gnyis dang*/ phyi ma gnyis kyi dbang du byas pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bsam gtan ni/ gnyis na bcu gnyis 'dod 'gro rnams/ /rang la dmigs brgyad gzugs med pa/ /gnyis kyi zhes byung*/ bsam gtan dang po gnyis na chos can/ 'dod pa'i yul la 'gro zhing dmigs pa'i tshe nyer rgyu bcu gnyis su 'gyur ba yod de/ yid mi bde ba drug ma gtogs bcu gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rang sa la dmigs pa'i tshe brgyad yod de/ rang sa'i gzugs sgra reg bya chos la dmigs pa'i bde ba bzhi btang snyoms bzhi ste brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med la dmigs pa'i tshe gnyis yod de/ yid bde dang btang snyoms gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gnyis na drug /drug gi 'dod pa'o rang ni bzhi'i/ /gong ma gcig gi dmigs pa yin/ /zhes byung*/bsam gtan phyi ma gnyis chos can/ khyod na drug yod de/ bco brgyad las btang snyoms drug tsam yod pa'i phyir/ khams gsum la dmigs tshul gyi sgo nas khyad par yod de/ 'dod pa'i yul la dmigs pa'i btang snyoms drug /rang sa'i yul bzhi la dmigs pa'i de bzhi/ gong ma gzugs med la dmigs pa'i de gcig yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gzugs med ni/ gzugs med nye bar bsdogs na bzhi/ / gzugs 'gro gong mar 'gro ba gcig /dngos gzhi na gcig rang gzugs can/ /zhes byung gzugs med chos can/ khyod kyi nyer bsdogs dang dngos gzhi'i tshor ba'i dmigs tshul yod de/ nam mkha' mtha' yas kyi nyer bsdogs na gzugs la dmigs shing 'gro ba bzhi dang*/ gong ma gzugs med la dmigs shing 'gro ba'i tshe chos la rgyu ba gcig kho na yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi dngos gzhi na gcig kho na yod de/ rang sa'i spyod yul can gyi chos la rgyu ba gcig kho na yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/

bco brgyad thams cad zag dang bcas/ /zhes byung*/ 'dir bstan pa'i yid tshor bco brgyad po thams cad chos can/ zag pa dang bcas pa yin te/ kun nas nyon mongs pa'i rten 'brel yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa 'chad 'gyur la ltos par ston pa ni/ bshad dang 'chad par 'gyur ba gzhan/ /zhes byung*/ skabs 'dir ni chos can/ rten 'brel gyi yan lag bzhi tsam gtso bor ston pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ rnam shes dang skye mched dang gzugs ni bshad zin la/ gzhan 'du byed dang sred pa gnyis ni las bstan pa dang*/ sred len gnyis ni phra rgyas ston pa'i skabs su 'chad par 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa nyon mongs dpes mtshon tshul la/ nyon mongs pa'i nyon mongs dpe lnga dang*/ las kyi kun nas nyon mongs dpe gsum dang*/ gzhi'i kun nas nyon mongs dpe gcig gis mtshon tshul gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dir ni nyon mongs sa bon bzhin/ /klu bzhin rtsa bzhin ljon shing bzhin/ /de bzhin shun pa bzhin du 'dod/ /ces byung*/ nyon mongs chos can/ dpe lnga dang mtshungs te/ 'dir na sa bon dang klu dang shing gi rtsa ba dang ljon shing dang shun lpags bzhin du 'dod pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ sa bon las sdong bu dang lo ma 'byung ba de bzhin du nyon mongs pa las las dang gzhi rnams 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ klu gnas pa'i mtsho mi bskam pa ltar nyon mongs yod na skye ba'i mtsho mi bskams pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ nags tshal gyi rtsa ba ma phyung na bcad kyang slar skye ba ltar nyon mongs rtsa ba nas ma spangs na slar skyes nas 'khor bar 'then pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa grub ste/ ljon shing las dus dus su me tog dang 'bras bu skye ba bzhin nyon mongs las ni las dang gzhi dus dus su 'byung ba'i phyir/ lnga pa grub ste/ 'bras shun lpags dang bcas pa las 'bras bu skye zhing de med na mi skye ba bzhin du nyon mongs song na las kyis gzhi'i myu gu skyed rnams kyi/

de med na mi skye ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ las ni shun bcas 'bras dang 'dra/ /de bzhin sman dang me tog bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ las chos can/ dpe gsum dang 'dra ste/ shun pa dang bcas pa'i 'bras dang smon dang me tog bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ shun lpags dang bcas pa'i 'bras kyis myu gu skyed pa bzhin du nyon mongs dang bcas pa'i las kyis rnam smin skyed nus pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ bcud phyung zin pa'i sman gyis slar 'bras bu mi 'byin pa bzhin du rnam smin phyung zin pa'i las kyis slar rnam smin mi 'byin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grub ste/ me tog rang gi 'bras bu'i nye rgyu yin pa bzhin du las ni rnam smin gyi nye rgyu yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzhi ni bza' btung grub pa bzhin/ zhes byung*/ 'bras bu rnam shes ming gzugs sogs gzhi bdun po chos can/ mtshon pa'i dpe gcig yod de/ dper na bza' btung g.yos grub pa de longs spyod bya kho na yin pa ltar khyod rnams rnam par smin zin kho na yin gyi/ rnam par smin byed ma yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa srid pa bzhi'i khyad par ni/ srid pa bzhi po de dag las/ /skye ba'i srid pa nyon mongs can/ /rang gi sa pa'i nyon mongs kun/ /gzhan rnam gsum po gzugs med gsum/ /zhes byung*/ srid pa chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ khyod la bar srid/ skye srid/ sngon dus/ 'chi srid rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi po de dag las skye ba'i srid pa chos can/ nyon mongs can yin te/ rang sa'i nyon mongs pa kun gyis nyon mongs pa can du byed pa'i phyir/ srid pa gzhan gsum po chos can/ khyod re re la'ang rnam pa gsum gsum yod de/ dge ba dang nyon mongs can dang lung ma bstan gsum re yod pa'i phyir/ gzugs med na srid pa gsum yod de/ bar srid ma gtogs gsum yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa gnas pa'i thabs la/ zas kyi byed las mdor bstan pa/

so sor rgyas par bshad pa/ grangs nges kyi don bsdur gsum/ dang po ni/ 'gro ba zas kyis gnas pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'gro ba rnams chos can/ gang gis gnas par byed pa yod de/ zas kyis gnas par byed pa yin pa'i phyir/ zas chos can/ khyod la bzhi yod de/ kham gyi zas/ reg pa'i zas/ sems pa'i zas/ rnam shes kyi zas dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ gzugs can gyi zas/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i zas/ zhar la bar srid kyi rnam grangs dang gsum/ dang po ni/ kham gyi zas ni 'dod pa na/ skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid do/ /gzugs kyi skye mched ma yin des/ /rang dbang grol ba mi phan phyir/ /zhes byung*/ kham gyi zas chos can/ ngo bo bzhag tu yod de/ kham du bcad cing mid pa'i zas zhig la 'jog pa'i phyir/ de la phra rags gnyis yod de/ phra ba ni bar srid pa dang lha rnams dang bskal ba dang po'i mi'i zas lta bu yin la/ rags pa ni da lta'i kham zas lta bu yin pa'i phyir te/ snga ma zos pas rgyu mthun gshang lci med cing*/ phyi ma zos pa la de yod pa'i phyir/ kham zas chos can/ khams gang du yod pa dang skye mched gang la 'jog pa yod de/ khyod ni 'dod pa na yod cing dri ro reg bya'i skye mched gsum gyi bdag nyid can yin pa'i phyir te/ khams gong ma gnyis ni kham zas la chags pa dang bral bas de gnyis na kham zas med cing*/ gzugs kyi skye mched ni kham zas ma yin pa'i phyir/ phyi ma der thal/ rang gi dbang po dang phrad pa'i sgo nas rang la mi phan pa'i phyir te/ kham zas la chags pa dang bral ba'i grol ba la/ zas kyi kha dog dang dbyibs mthong bar mi phan pa lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ /gnyis pa ni/ reg dang sems pa rnam shes ni/ zag bcas zas yin gsum dag na/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs can ma yin pa'i zas chos can/ khyod la gsum yod de/ zag bcas kyi reg pa dang sems pa dang rnam shes gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum po chos can/ khams gcig kho nar yod par ma nges te/

khams gsum po dag na yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum chos can/ rten gnas byed kyi zas yin te/ reg pas sems sems byung rgyas par byed/ sems pas gnas pa dang 'phel bar byed/ gnas ni rnam shes kyis byed pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yid las byung dang srid tshol dang*/ /dri za srid pa bar ma dang*/ /'grub pa'o zhes byung*/ bar srid pa chos can/ yid las byung ba zhes bya ste/ brdos bcas kyi lus rags pa med par yid tsam las skyes pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ srid tshol zhes bya ste/ srid pa tshol ba'i ngang tshul can yin pa'i phyir/ dri za zhes bya ste/ zas su dri za ba tsam yin pa'i phyir/ srid pa bar ma zhes bya ste/ 'chi srid dang skye srid gnyis kyi bar gyi srid pa yin pa'i phyir/ mngon par 'grub pa zhes bya ste/ skye srid pa mngon du phyogs pa yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa grangs kyi sgo nas don bsdu ba ni/ 'di la gnas dang ni/ rten pa rgyas pa'i don du gnyis/ /srid gzhan 'phen dang 'grub pa yi/ /don du gnyis te go rim bzhin/ /zhes so/ /shes bya chos can/ zas la de ltar bzhir bshad pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshe 'di la gnas pa'i dbang po dang bcas pa'i lus rgyas pa'i don du kham zas dang*/ rten pa sems sems byung rgyas pa'i don du reg pa'i zas gnyis dang*/ srid pa gzhan du 'phen pa dang 'grub pa yi don du sems pa dang rnam shes kyi zas gnyis te go rim bzhin du bzhag pa'i/ khams yin na/ zas yin pas ma khyab ste/ zag med kyi khams rnams zas ma yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zas ni zag bcas kyi steng nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ de'i zas yin na/ de'i dbang po dang 'byung ba la phan par ma khyab ste/ de'i zas yin yang 'byung ba la gnod pa yod pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa 'chi 'pho ba'i sems la/ sems gang gis 'chi ba/ tshor ba gang gis 'chi ba zhar byung dang bcas pa/ lus kyi phyogs gang nas 'chi ba/ gnod gcod pa'i rgyu dang bzhi/

dang po ni/ chad dang mtshams sbyor 'dod chags bral/ /nyams dang 'chi 'pho skye ba rnams/ /yid kyi rnam shes kho nar 'dod/ / ces byung*/ /shes bya chos can/ sems gang gis 'chi ba yod de/ dge rtsa chad pa dang*/ dge rtsa mtshams sbyor ba dang*/ 'dod chags dang bral ba'i mnyam gzhag dang*/ de yongs su nyams pa dang*/ 'chi 'pho ba dang*/ skye ba'i skabs kyi sems rnams gtso bor yid kyi rnam shes kyis byed pa kho nar 'dod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chi 'pho skye la btang snyoms la/ /rtse gcig sems med la de med/ /mya ngan 'das lung bstan min gnyis/ /zhes byung*/ tshor ba gang gis 'chi ba yod de/ 'chi 'pho dang skye ba len pa gnyis la tshor ba gsum gyi nang nas btang snyoms kho nar nges pa'i phyir te/ tshor ba bde sdug gnyis rnam pa ches gsal bas de la mi rung ba'i phyir/ rtse gcig pa'i mnyam gzhag dang*/ sems med 'gog pa dang 'du shes med pa'i snyoms 'jug lta bu'i ngang nas 'chi 'pho byed pa med de/ de la de ltar 'gyur ba med pa'i phyir/ lhag med du mya ngan las 'da' ba'i 'chi sems la rnam smin skyes dang spyod lam pa'i lung ma bstan gnyis yod kyi/ dge mi dge'i sems med de/ sems rgyun chad kha ma la de gnyis mi rung ba'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ 'og mi lhar 'gro mi skye rnams/ /rim gyis 'chi na rkang pa dang*/ /lte ba snying kar yid 'chi 'pho/ /zhes byung*/ 'og ngan 'gror skye ba rnams chos can/ rim gyis 'chi ba yin na rkang pa nas yid 'gag cing 'chi 'pho ste/ de'i tshe rnam shes kyi rten lus dbang rkang par bsdus nas 'gag par byed pa'i phyir/ mi'i nang du 'gro ba rim gyis 'chi ba rnams chos can/ phyogs gang nas 'chi tshul yod de/ yid lte ba ru/ 'gags shing 'chi ba'i phyir/ lha dang las nyon gyis mi skye ba'i dgra bcom pa dag chos can/ 'chi tshul yod de/ snying kar yid 'chi 'pho byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/

gnad gcod pa ni chu sogs kyis/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gnad gcod gang gis byed pa yod de/ rlung mkhris sogs la brten pa'i rlung me chu sogs kyis gcod par byed pa'i phyir/ gang gcod pa yod de/ lus kyi gnad nyams na 'chi bar byed pa ni gcod pa'i don yin pa'i phyir te/ lus kyis rnam shes kyi rten byed pa'i nus pa bcad pa de bcad pa'i don yin pa'i phyir/ lha la gnad gcod khyad par ba med de/ rang 'grel las/ lha dag gi nang na ni gnad chad pa med mod kyi/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'dod lha la 'chi ba'i tshe sdug bsngal med pa ni min te/ 'chi ltas mthong nas sdug bsngal du 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ lnga pa sems can gyi tshogs gsum du sdud pa ni/ 'phags dang mtshams med byed pa dag /yang dag log pa nyid du nges/ /zhes byung*/ 'phags pa rgyun zhugs sogs chos can/ tshogs dang po yang dag pa nyid du nges pa yin te/ myang 'das mngon du byed par nges pa'i phyir/ 'tshams med byed pa rnams chos can/ tshogs gnyis pa log pa nyid du nges te/ ngan song du skye bar nges pa'i phyir/ de las gzhan pa'i so skye rnams chos can/ tshogs gsum pa ma nges pa zhes bya ste/ de gnyis gang rung du mtha' gcig tu ma nges pa'i phyir te/ rkyen sgrub pa la ltos pa'i phyir ro// //gnyis pa phyi snod kyi 'jig rten bshad pa la/ bshad tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ gzhung don bye brag tu bshad pa'o/ /dang po yod de/ /phal chen dang yab sras mjal ba'i mdo dang sa sde dang dus 'khor sogs nas bshad tshul mi 'dra ba du ma 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa la/ rten dkyil 'khor gsum bshad pa/ brten pa ri mtsho gling gsum bshad pa/ tsha grang dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa/ nyi zla'i 'char tshul dang tshad bshad pa/ lha'i gnas bshad pa/ stong gsum ngos bzung ba/ 'gro ba rnams kyi lus dang tshe tshad bshad pa/ tshad de gzhal ba'i thabs bshad pa/

snod bcud kyi khyad chos bye brag tu bshad pa dang dgu /dang po la/ rlung dang chu dang sa dkyil bshad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ mdzod las/ de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi/ /gnas par 'dod pa'i 'og dag gi /rlung gi dkyil 'khor rngams su ni/ sa ya drug 'bum grangs med do/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ snod bcud gnyis yod pa de la snod kyi 'jig rten gyi khams stong gsum 'di'i 'og gzhir rtan rlung gi dkyil 'khor chen po gcig gnas par 'dod pa de'i chags tshul yod de/ dang po nam mkha' ltar stong par gnas pa las sems can spyi mthun gyi las stobs kyis lo du mar rlung 'jam po rim gyis 'khrigs pa las 'thab bral yan chad chags pa'i rjes su chags pa'i phyir/ rlung dkyil de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ rngams te dpangs su dpag tshad sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum yod cing*/ rgyar dpag tshad grags med cig yod pa'i phyir/ rlung dkyil 'di'i rgyar dpag tshad de ltar mang ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ stong gsum 'jig rten khams kyi 'og gi rlung dkyil ni gcig gis go chod cing*/ chu sa rnams so so ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ chu rngams 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang*/ stong phrag dag ni nyi shu'o/ /zhes byung*/ chu dkyil chos can/ khyod chags tshul yod de/ rlung dkyil gyi steng du sems can rnams kyi las kyis sprin gser gyi snying po can 'dus te char gi rgyun shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam mam gnya' shing tsam lo du mar babs pa las chags pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag bcu gcig dang stong phrag dag ni nyi shu ste nyi khri yod pa'i phyir/ gser gyi snying po can zhes pa'i don yod de/ bsrubs na gser 'byung rung gi snying po can yin pa'i phyir/ chu mtha' chos can/ phyir mi 'pho ste/ sems can gyi las dbang gis 'dzin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ phyis ni rngams su 'bum phrag brgyad/

lhag ma dag ni gser du 'gyur/ /chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gyi/ / thad kar 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang*/ /stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag na/ / phyed dang lnga rnams kho na'o/ khor yug tu ni sum 'gyur ro/ /zhes byung*/ gser dkyil chos can/ khyod chags tshul yod de/ sngar gyi chu dkyil de sems can spyi mthun gyi las stobs kyis rlung gis bsrubs pa las phyis ni rngams su dpag tshad 'bum phrag brgyad du gyur te/ lhag ma sum 'bum nyi khri dag ni chu de'i steng du khyod du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ de yang sa'i dkyil 'khor logs nas 'ongs pa min gyi chu dkyil snga ma de'i sum cha gser gyi dkyil 'khor du 'gyur ba yin te/ dper na 'o ma'i steng gi sbris ma chags pa ltar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor gnyis po chos can/ khyod kyi rgya tshad mnyam pa yin te/ thad kar che chung med par 'bum phrag bcu gnyis dang stong phrag gsum dang brgya phrag ni phyed dang lnga rnams kho nar nges pa'i phyir/ de gnyis chos can/ khyod kyi khor yug gi tshad yod de/ khor yug tu ni zheng gi sum 'gyur 'bum phrag sum cu rtsa bdun te sum 'bum bdun khri dang brgya phrag phyed dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir te/ zlum po'i mtha' skor ni zheng gi sum 'gyur du nges pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cigasnod chags pa'i thog ma rlung gi dkyil 'khor chags pa nas yin gsung pa ni mi 'thad de/ tshangs pa'i 'jig rten thog mar chags nas rlung dkyil rjes su chags pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mes 'jig gi rjes su de ltar chags par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ 'dod khams chags pa'i snod kyi thog ma yang rlung dkyil nas ma yin te/ tshangs ris nas 'thab bral gyi bar chags pa'i rjes su rlung dkyil chags pa rang 'grel dang 'grel bshad las gsal bar bshad pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang*/ chags pa dang po'i rlung nas ni zhes pa dang mi 'gal te de ni thog ma'i rlung yin gyi rlung dkyil de'i dbang du byas pa ma yin pa'i phyir/

khor yug gi phyi mtha' ru chu dang gser dkyil gyi lhag ma med pa ni min te/ lcags ri'i phyi rol tu yang phyogs re rer de gnyis dpag tshad stong dang nyis brgya dang brgyad cu rtsa phyed dang brgyad re lhag lus pa yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rgyal sras ma las/ de ni khor yug gi phyi rol na chu dang gser gyi dkyil 'khor de tsam lhag pa'i phyir nyes pa med do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa la/ ri dgu rgyu dang dbyibs tshad kyi sgo nas bshad pa/ mtsho brgyad kyi dbyibs tshad bshad pa/ gling bzhi gling phran brgyad kyi tshad dbyibs bshad pa/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ de la lhun po gnya' shing 'dzin/ /gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldeng can/ /de bzhin blta na sdug ri dang*/ /rta rna dang ni rnam 'dud dang*/ /mu khyud 'dzin ri'o de nas ni/ /gling rnams yin no de dag gi /phyi rol na ni khor yug ste/ /bdun ni gser yin de lcags so/ /lhun po rin chen bzhi'i rang bzhin/ /chu yi nang du brgyad khri dag /nub po de bzhin steng du yang*/ /dpag tshad dag ni brgyad khri'o/ /brgyad po'i 'phang du phyed phyed dbri/ /de dag rngams su'ang 'phang dang mnyam/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gser dkyil gyi steng de la char gyi rgyun sngar bzhin babs pa las rgya mtsho chen po dpangs su dpag tshad brgyad khri yod pa zhig chags pa rlung gis bsrubs pas khams rab las ri rnams kyi dbus su ri gzhan las lhun brjid che ba'i lhun po chags/ yang de ltar bsrubs pas khams 'bring las gser ri gnya' shing 'dzin dang gshol mda' 'dzin dang seng ldeng can dang de bzhin du blta na sdug ri dang rta rna dang rnam 'dud dang mu khyud 'dzin ri bdun gru bzhir bskor ba'i tshul gyis chags shing*/ yang khams tha ma las de nas phyi rol tu ni gling rnams kyang chags nas gnas pa'i phyir/ de dag gi phyi rol na ni khor yug tu bskor ba'i lcags ri yod cing de rnams kyi rgyu'i khyad par yod de/

gnya' shing 'dzin sogs ri bdun ni gser dang*/ khor yug de lcags las grub pa'i phyir/ lhun po chos can/ rin po che bzhi'i rang bzhin las grub pa yin te/ shar dngul/ lho bai ḍūr+ya/ nub shel/ byang gser las grub pa'i phyir/ de'i rgyu mtshan gyis gling so so'i ngos kyi nam mkha' yang de dag gi mdog tu snang ba yin te/ rang 'grel las/ gang gi rang bzhin yin pa de'i mthus de'i nam mkha' yang de'i kha dog tu snang ste/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ lho phyogs kyi nam mkha' sngon por snang ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ ri rab kyi lho ngos bai ḍūr+ya sngon po'i rang bzhin can yin pa'i dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ ri dgu po chos can/ khyod kyi dpangs tshad yod de/ chu'i nang du gser dkyil la thug par dpag tshad brgyad khri re mnyam par nub cing ri rab ni de bzhin du chu'i steng du yang dpag tshad dag ni brgyad khri 'phags pa'i phy-ir/ gnya' shing 'dzin sogs ri gzhan brgyad po ni chos can/ chu'i steng du snga ma las phyi ma 'phang ste rngams su phyed phyed dbri ba yin te/ gnya' shing 'dzin gyi chu mtshams yan chad la dpag tshad bzhi khri/ de bzhin du gnyis pa la de'i phyed nyis khri/ gsum pa la chig khri/ bzhi pa la lnga stong*/ lnga pa la nyis stong lnga brgya/ drug pa la chig stong dang phyed dang sum brgya/ bdun pa la drug brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pa'i phyir/ ri brgyad po de dag chos can/ chu mtshams yan gyi rngams su'ang 'phang ste 'dir zheng dang tshad mnyam pa yin te/ rgya dpangs gnyis mnyam pa'i phyir/ 'di ltar na 'phang la rngams zheng gnyis kyi sgra 'jug par gsal zhing*/ ri phyi ma las nang ma mthug pa'i dbang ngo*/ /ri lhag ma bdun chos can/ khyod kyi ngos bzhi'i dkyus tshad yod de/ snga ma las phyi ma che ba'i phyir te/ snga ma las phyi ma'i dkyus tshad rang gi snga ma'i mtsho dang rang gi zheng tshad nyis 'gyur res lhag pa'i phyir/

gnya' shing 'dzin chos can/ khyod kyi ngos re dang mtha' skor gyi tshad gnyis yod de/ phyi'i ngos gcig gi zur nas zur du dpag tshad sum 'bum nyis khri dang*/ mthar de'i bzhi 'gyur sa ya gcig dang nyis 'bum brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/ zur snga ma grub ste/ ri rab dang de'i g.yas g.yon gyi mtsho dang rang gi zheng tshad gnyis rnams bsdoms pa la tshad de ltar yod pa'i phyir/ de bzhin du gshol mda' 'dzin chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer bzhi 'bum bzhi khri re dang mthar sa ya gcig dang bdun 'bum drug khri yod pa'i phyir/ seng ldeng can chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer lnga 'bum re dang mthar sa ya gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ blta na sdug ri chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer lnga 'bum sum khri re dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum nyis khri yod pa'i phyir/ rta rna chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer lnga 'bum bzhi khri lnga stong re dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/ rnam 'dud chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer lnga 'bum lnga khri nyis stong lnga brgya re dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum chig khri yod pa'i phyir/ mu khyud 'dzin chos can/ ngos re dang mtha'i tshad yod de/ ngos rer lnga 'bum lnga khri drug stong phyed dang sum brgya re dang mtha' skor du sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum nyis khri lnga stong yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig cung zad mi 'dra ba re bshad kyang don ni 'di kho na ltar ro/ /ri bdun po chos can/ so so'i sgra bshad yod de/ nyi zla gnya' shing ltar 'dzin pa'am rtse mo na brag gnya' shing lta bu yod pas na gnya' shing 'dzin dang*/ de bzhin du rtse mo gshol mda' ltar yod pa dang*/ rtse mor seng ldeng gi nags yod pa dang*/ rtse mo lta na sdug cing mdzes par yod pa dang*/ rtse mo rta'i rna ba ltar yod pa dang*/

rtse mo dbus su 'dud pa'i tshul du yod pa dang*/ rtse mo 'khor lo'i mu khyud ltar yod pas na de ltar du brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de dag bar bdun rol mtsho yin/ /dang po stong phrag brgyad cu'o/ /de ni nang gi rgya mtsho yin/ /de yi ngos la sum 'gyur ro/ /rol mtsho gzhan ni phyed phyed do/ /lhag ma phyi yi rgya mtsho yin/ /'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag ni/ nyi shu gnyis so zhes byung*/ rol mtsho bdun po chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ lhun po nas mu khyud 'dzin la thug pa de dag gi bar bdun gyi mtsho bdun po de khyod du 'jog pa yin pa'i phyir/ mtsho dang po chos can/ khyod kyi zheng tshad yod de/ stong phrag brgyad cu ste brgyad khri yod pa'i phyir/ de ni chos can/ nang gi rgya mtsho yin te/ mtsho brgyad kyi nang ma yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi ngos tshad yod de/ rang gi thad ka'i sum 'gyur yod pa'i phyir te/ ngos re la nyis 'bum bzhi khri re dang mthar de'i bzhi 'gyur dgu 'bum drug khri yod pa'i phyir/ rol mtsho gzhan drug gi kha zheng ni snga ma las phyi ma phyed phyed kyis dbri ba yin te/ rim bzhin bzhi khri dang nyis khri dang chig khri dang lnga stong dang*/ phyed dang sum stong dang chig stong nyis brgya lnga bcu yod pa'i phyir/ mtsho de rnams chos can/ dkyus tshad snga ma las phyi ma che ste/ rol mtsho dang po'i ngos rer dpag tshad nyis 'bum bzhi khri dang mthar dgu 'bum drug khri/ gnyis pa'i ngos rer bzhi 'bum re dang mthar sa ya gcig dang drug 'bum/ gsum pa'i ngos rer bzhi 'bum brgyad khri re dang mthar sa ya gcig dang dgu 'bum nyi khri/ bzhi pa'i ngos rer lnga 'bum nyis khri dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang brgyad khri/ lnga pa'i ngos rer lnga 'bum bzhi khri re dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang chig 'bum drug khri/ drug pa'i ngos rer lnga 'bum lnga khri re dang mthar sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum/

bdun pa'i ngos rer lnga 'bum lnga khri lnga stong re dang mtha' skor du bzhi 'gyur sa ya gnyis dang nyis 'bum nyi khri yod pa'i phyir/ bdun po de chos can/ rol mtsho zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ dga' bo dang nye dga' la sogs klu yi rgyal po rnams rtse zhing rol bas na de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ mtsho snga ma bdun po nang gi rgya mtsho yin la/ mu khyud 'dzin dang khor yug gi bar gyi mtsho chos can/ phyi'i rgya mtsho zhes bya ste/ mtsho gzhan gyi phyi'i lhag ma'i rgya mtsho yin pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi zheng tshad yang de/ de'i bar la dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang stong phrag dag ni nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ /gsum pa gling rnams tshad dbyibs kyi sgo nas bshad pa ni/ de la ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling ste ngos gsum la/ /stong phrag gnyis so shing rta'i dbyibs/ / gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ /shar gyi lus 'phags zla gam 'dra/ /ngos gsum 'di dang 'dra gcig la/ /dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu'o/ /ba lang spyod gling zlum po ste/ /stong phrag phyed dang brgyad yin no/ /de'i dbus stong phrag phyed dang gsum/ /sgra mi snyan brgyad gru bzhir mnyam/ /de yi bar gyi gling brgyad ni/ /lus dang lus 'phags sgra mi snyan/ /sgra mi snyan gyi zla dang ni/ /rnga yab dang ni rnga yab gzhan/ /g.yo ldan dang ni lam mchog 'gro/ /zhes byung*/ gling rnams chos can/ gang la gnas pa yod de/ phyi'i rgya mtshor rtsa bas gzhir thug pa'i tshul gyis gnas pa'i phyir/ ri rab kyi lho na yod pa'i 'dzam bu'i gling chos can/ khyod kyi sgra don dbyibs tshad sogs yod de/ shing 'dzam bu'i 'bras bu mtsho nang du lhung ba'i sgra dang shing des mtshon pas na 'dzam bu'i gling dang*/ dbyibs shing rta lta bu dang*/ ngos gzhan gsum la dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis re dang*/ lho phyogs kyi ngos gcig la dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

shar gyi lus 'phags gling chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs tshad sogs yod de/ dbyibs ni zla kham dang 'dra la/ tshad ni ngos gsum 'dzam bu'i gling 'di dang 'dra bar dpag tshad stong phrag gnyis re dang lcags ri'i phyogs kyi ngos gcig la dpag tshad sum brgya lnga bcu yod pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ lus 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i lus las 'phags shing mdzes pas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ nub phyogs kyi ba lang spyod chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs tshad yod de/ dbyibs zlum po dang*/ tshad ni mthar dpag tshad stong phrag phyaid dang brgyad yin la de'i dbus thad kar zheng la dpag tshad stong phrag phyed dang gsum yod pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ ba lang dang nor bu la spyod pas na de skad brjod pa'i phyir/ byang gi sgra mi snyan chos can/ khyod kyi dbyibs tshad yod de/ dbyibs grub bzhir mnyam zhing*/ tshad ni ngos rer dpag tshad nyis stong re yod cing mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong phrag brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ de na yod pa'i mi rnams 'chi ba'i tshe zhag bdun gyi gong du 'chi'o zhes pa'i sgra mi snyan pa nam mkha' las 'byung bas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ gling de rnams chos can/ khyod la gling zhes brjod pa'i sgra don yod de/ mtha' chus bskor ba'i tshul gyis so sor gnas pas na de skad ces brjod pa'i phyir/ gling de dag na bya ba byed tshul dang*/ mi rnams kyi byad dbyibs kyi khyad par yod de/ gling gzhan na ched du byas pa'i kha zas za la/ sgra mi snyan na ma rmos pa'i lo tog sogs la spyod/ snga ma gsum na bag ma gtong len dang nyo tshong dang gnas khang 'bub pa sogs yod/ sgra mi snyan na de lta bu med la/ byad dbyibs kyi khyad par ni gdong rang rang gi gling gi dbyibs lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gling bzhi po de'i b.ragyis gling chos can/ khyod la brgyad yod de/ g.yon skor gyis shar du lus dang lus 'phags gnyis/

byang du sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla gnyis/ nub tu g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro gnyis/ lhor rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan gnyis te brgyad yod pa'i phyir/ gling phran brgyad po de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad dbyibs yod de/ rang gi dbus kyi gling las phyed kyis chung zhing dbyibs ni rang rang gi dbus kyi gling lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ mkhas pa kha cigagling g.yog rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i gling dang tshad 'dra bar 'dod kyang mi 'thad de/ de brgyad na gnas pa'i mi'i lus ni dbus gling gi mi rnams las phyed kyis chung bar bshad pas kyang gling g.yog rnams dbus gling las chung bar grub pa'i phyir/ rnga yab gling na mir ma zad de/ de na srin po yang gnas pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa 'dzam bu'i gling gi yon tan bye brag tu bshad pa ni/ 'di nas byang du ri nag po/ /dgu 'das gangs ri'o de nas ni/ /spos ngad ldang ba'i tshu rol na/ /mchu zheng lnga bcu yod pa'i mtsho/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dzam gling 'di ni khyad chos du ma dang ldan te/ rdo rje gdan 'di nas byang du ri nag po gsum gsum ste dgu 'das pa'i pha rol na gangs ri chen po ti se zhes bya ba yod cing*/ de nas kyang pha rol dpag tshad lnga bcu na spos ngad ldang ba'i ri bo yod la/ yang de nas dpag tshad lnga bcu'i tshu rol na klu'i rgyal po ma dros pa gnas pa'i mtsho ma dros pa zhes bya ba dbyibs gru bzhi dang*/ mchu zhing gnyis la'ang dpag tshad lnga bcu re yod cing*/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad nyis brgya pa yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus gang ba zhig yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi dbus na shing khyad par can yod de/ der 'dzam bu'i shing 'bras bu mngar mo dang ldan pa lhas kyang longs spyod du rung ba'i shing khyad par can yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi phyogs bzhi nas chu bo chen po bzhi 'bab pa yin te/ shar na dngul gyi brag glang chen 'dra ba'i kha nas gaṅgā dngul gyi bye ma 'dren pa dang*/

lhor gser gyi brag khyu mchog gi kha 'dra ba nas sin+dhu gser gyi bye ma dang*/ nub na bai ḍūr+ya'i brag rta'i kha 'dra ba nas pak+ṣu bai ḍūr+ya'i bye ma dang*/ byang na rdo rje'i brag seṅge'i kha 'dra ba nas si ta zhes bya ba rdo rje'i bye ma 'dren cing*/ de re re 'ang chu bran lnga brgya re bcas nas mtsho ma dros pa la g.yas skor lan bdun re byas nas rang rang gi phyogs su 'bab pa'i phyir/ de ltar 'bab pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ klu rgyal ma dros pa de sprul pa'i klu khyad par can yin zhing de'i smon lam gyi mtshon don khyad par can dang ldan pa'i sgo nas de ltar du 'bab pa'i phyir/ ri spos ngad ldang chos can/ khyod kyi byang phyogs dpag tshad nyi shu na brag gser gyi bya skyibs zhes bya ba rang 'dra brgya stong gis bskor ba yod de/ zhing du dpag tshad lnga bcu/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang bzhi/ mthar dpag tshad nyis brgya yod pa/ lta na sdug cing mdzes pa yin pa'i phyir/ bya skyibs de chos can/ khyod kyi byang dang shar na shing dang rdzing bu gnyis yod de/ byang na shing sā la'i rab brtan dang shar na rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab pa zhes bya ba gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ sngar bshad pa de dag gi nye skor du gang rgyu ba yod de/ brgya byin gyi glang chen g.yul ngor spyod pa rab brtan zhes bya ba srid du dpag tshad phyed dang gsum dang*/ zheng du dpag tshad gcig /'phang du dpag tshad phyed gnyis yod pa 'khor glang po che brgya stong dang bcas dgun gser gyi bya skyibs dang*/ dpyid sā la rab brtan dang*/ dbyar rdzing bu dal gyis 'bab par gnas pa'i phyir/ 'dzam gling chos can/ khyod kyi khyad chos gzhan yang yod de/ dbus su sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs gnas rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi shing dang bcas pa/ shar na 'jam dpal gyi gnas ri bo rtse lnga/ lho na spyan ras gzigs kyi gnas gru 'dzin/ nub na mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod kyi gnas o ḍi yan/

byang na chos rgyal rigs ldan so gnyis sam so gsum gyi gnas sham+bha la yod pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang khyad par du ma bshad pa yod de/ gling 'di la gling g.yog lnga brgya dang*/ yul phran stong dang bco brgyad dang*/ bcu drug sogs du ma bshad pa'i phyir te gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i mdo las yul ka sha dang ba hu dang tho gar la sogs pa stong dang*/ dran pa nyer gzhag las bco brgyad dang*/ gsang ba'i mdo las bcu drug dang*/ lung phran tshegs las mnyan yod la sogs pa drug kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ gsum pa dmyal ba'i gnas bshad pa ni/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na/ /mnar med pa'o de tsam mo/ /de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun/ /brgyad po kun las lhag bcu drug /de dag gi ni ngos bzhi na/ /me mar mur dang ro myags dang*/ /spu gri'i lam sogs chu bo yin/ /chu bur can sogs grang brgyad gzhan/ /zhes byung*/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'di chos can/ khyod kyi 'og tu dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu na mnar med pa'i dmyal ba'i yas steng yod de/ de nas de'i rngams su thur dang rgya tshad la'ang dpag tshad stong phrag nyi shu de tsam re yod pa'i phyir/ sa sde las ma dros mtsho'i 'og tu bshad pa dang mi 'gal te/ ma dros mtsho ni gling 'di'i mtsho'i bye brag yin pa'i phyir/ mnar med de yi steng na dmyal ba bdun yod de/ yang sos sogs bdun yod pa'i phyir/ tsha dmyal brgyad po kun chos can/ 'khor du ma yod de/ khyod re re la'ang lhag ma 'khor bcu drug re yod pa'i phyir/ der thal/ brgyad pa de dag gi ngos bzhi re re na me mar mur gyi 'obs/ ro myags kyi 'dam/ spu gri gtams pa'i lam/ sogs te chu bo rab med bzhi bzhi la lcags ris bskor nas yod pa'i phyir/ sogs sgras gzhan yang sdud de/ ral gri'i lo ma dang shal ma li sogs sdud pa'i phyir/ tsha dmyal brgyad po chos can/ khyod kyi thad kar gzhan grang dmyal brgyad yod de/ de dag tu chu bur can la sogs pa brgyad yod pa'i phyir/

ngan song gzhan yi dwags kyi gnas yod de/ gnas kyi rtsa ba ni 'dzam gling 'di'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya song ba na yi dwags kyi grong khyer ser skya zhes bya ba yod pa'i phyir/ der ma nges te/ yi dwags 'ga' zhig dang*/ nye tshe ba'i dmyal ba'i gnas rgya mtsho'i 'gram dang mi yul na'ang yod pa'i phyir/ yi dwags dang dmyal ba'i gshin rje'i rgyal po ni gang zag tu 'dod cing ngo bo gcig tu bzhed pa dang mi bzhed pa'i tshul gnyis yod la/ thig nag po 'debs mkhan la sogs pa'i gshin rje'i gzugs su snang ba la 'dod tshul gnyis yod de/ bye smras gang zag tu 'dod cing*/ mdo sde pa dang dbu sems rnams kyis 'byung bzhi'i khyad par la 'dod ces bshad pa'i phyir/ dud 'gro'i gnas yod de/ thang dang chu dang nam mkha' sogs la gnas pa yod kyang rtsa ba'i gnas ni rgya mtsho chen po nyid yin pa'i phyir/ lha ma yin gyi gnas yod de/ ri rab kyi chu 'tshams man gyi khong seng na gtso bor gnas shing*/ kha 'thor ni gzhan dag na'ang yod pa'i phy-ir/ dang po grub ste/ chu mtshams man gyi khong seng na dang po lha ma yin gyi dbang po sgra gcan 'khor bcas dang*/ de nas 'og tu mgul phreng dang*/ de nas brtan pa dang*/ de nas thag bzang ris 'khor bcas yod par gdags pa las bshad pa'i phyir/ lha min rnams kyi yo byad kyi khyad par yod de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams la ji ltar yod pa lta bu'i dod re re yod pa'i phyir te/ mtshon na lha'i glang chen g.yul ngor spyod pa'i dod du/ lha min la glang chen bzod dka' yod pa bzhin no/ /de'i phyir de rnams kyis sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha la 'gran nus pa yin te/ 'on kyang lha rnams ni bsod nams mthu che ba yin no/ /bzhi pa nyi zla'i 'char tshul la/ dngos dang*/ dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag gnyis/ dang po ni/ nyi zla lhun po'i phyed na'o/ /dpag tsad lnga bcu gcig dang bcas/ nam phyed nyi ma nub pa dang*/

nyi ma phyed dang 'char dus gcig/zhes byung*/ nyi zla gnyis chos can/ khyod gang nas 'char ba'i tshul yod de/ lhun po'i chu 'tshams yan chad kyi phyed gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo dang mnyam pa'i thad nas 'char ba'i phyir/ gang gis rten byas nas 'char ba yod de/ sems can gyi las kyi mthus rang nyid 'debs byed dang 'phul byed kyi rlung stobs kyis 'char ba'i phyir/ nyi zla skar gsum 'phul byed kyi rlung la mgyogs bul khyad par yod de/ skar ma nyi zla gsum rim pa bzhin snga ma mgyogs shing*/ phyi ma bul ba'i phyir/ nyi ma'i lho byang gi bgrod gnyis kyi tshe mtho dman mi mnyam ste/ byang bgrod kyi tshe mtho la lho bgrod kyi tshe de las dma' ba'i phyir/ spyir nyi zla gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo dang mnyam pa dag 'char bar bshad pa ni ston dpyid lta bu'i dus kyi tshe yin yang*/ de'i tshe gnya' shing 'dzin gyi rtse mo'i thad ka na yod pa min te/ nyi zla byang bgrod mthar thug gi dus su yang lho gling 'di'i dbus nas byang phyogs su mi 'ong ba'i phyir/ nyi zla'i tshad yod de/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyar ni dpag tshad lnga bcu dang*/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyar dpag tshad nga gcig dang bcas la/ gnyis ka'i mtha' skor du ni sum 'gyur dang*/ gnyis ka rngams su dpag tshad phyed dang drug dang gcig gi bco brgyad cha gcig yod pa'i phyir/ ngo bo'i khyad par yod de/ nyi ma'i 'og ngos me shel dang zla ba'i 'og ngos chu shel las grub cing*/ de gnyis ka'i steng na gser gyi rwa ba 'phang du dpag tshad phyed pas bskor ba yod cing*/ skyed mos tshal sogs dang*/ nang du lha'i grong khyer du ma dang*/ lha'i bu nyi ma dang zla ba 'khor bcas gnas pa'i phyir/ zla ba'i ngos kyi gzugs brnyan de la bshad tshul mi 'dra ba yod kyang ston pa'i ri bong du skye ba bzhes pa'i ri bong gi gzugs brnyan bris pa ltar 'dod par bya ste/

ri bong can zhes pa dang mthun pa'i phyir/ skar ma'i grangs tshad yod de/ gling bzhi gcig la skar ma dung 'phyur gnyis dang bye ba brgyad sa ya lnga yod cing*/ tshad che ba la rgyang grag bco brgyad dang*/ 'bring la bcu dang bcu gnyis bar dang*/ chung bar rgyang grags gsum dang gcig yod par bshad pa'i phyir/ phyed las yod de/ nyi mas grangs rnams dro ba dang zla bas tsha ba rnams bsil bar byed cing*/ rtse shing lo tog sogs skyed pa'i grogs byed cing*/ gnod pa'ang ci rigs byed par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bya ba byed tshul yod de/ mtshon na sgra mi snyan du nam phyed pa de'i tshe lus 'phags su nyi ma nub pa dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir nyi ma phyed pa dang ba lang spyod du nyi ma shar ba bzhi dus mnyam pa de bzhin du gling gzhan la'ang 'gre ba'i phyir/ 'di la'ang 'dod pa mi 'dra ba yod de/ nyin mtshan mnyam pa'i dus gcig la 'dod pa dang*/ nyen zhag re re 'ang de ltar 'gyur ba'i 'dod tshul gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ rang lugs de phyi ma ltar rung ste/ rje nor bzang pas legs par gtan la phab pa ltar 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa dus tshigs ni/ dbyar gyi zla ba gnyis pa yi/ tha ma'i tshes dgu nas mtshan ring*/ /dgun rnams kyi ni bzhi pa la/ /thung ngur 'gyur ro nyin mo bzlog /nyin mtshan ring pa thang gcig go /nyi ma lho byang bgrod tshe'o/ /nyi ma dang ni nye ba las/ /rang gi grib mas sgrib par snang*/ /zhes byung*/ 'di la tshig don dang*/ spyi don dang*/ mtha' dpyad pa gsum/ dang po ni/ rags rtsis dus tshigs la gsum du phye ba'i zla ba gnyis pa khrums zla'i phyogs tha ma hor zla brgyad pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bdun brgyad la nyin mtshan mnyam pa las/ tshes dgu nas mtshan mo ring bar 'gyur te/ de nas zla ba gsum gyi bar zla ba re rer thang cig sum cu'am yud tsam bco brgyad kyi bar du rim gyis 'phel nas bcu gcig pa'i tshes brgyad la dgun nyi ldog cing*/
