de nas zla ba gsum gyi bar du thang cig dang yud tsam res nyin mo ring ba dang mtshan mo thung ngur rim gyis gyur te/ dus tshigs la gsum du phye ba'i dgun rnams kyi ni zla ba bzhi pa dbo zla'i yar ngo gnyis pa'i tshes brgyad la dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam pa 'byung zhing*/ de nas yang mtshan mo thung ngu dang nyin mo ring bar gyur te zla ba gsum rdzogs pa'i tshe lnga pa'i tshes brgyad lta bu la dbyar nyi mthar thug 'byung ba sogs yin pa'i phyir/ nyin mo bzlog zhes pa'i don yang yod de/ nyin mtshan ring thung go bzlog tu 'byung ba la byed kyi/ nyi ldog gi dus tsam la mi byed pa'i phyir/ dgun nyi ldog pa nas nyin mo ring bar 'gro yang de mtshan mo las ring bar ma nges te/ mtshan mo las nyin mo ring ba ni dpyid nyin mtshan mnyam zin nas 'byung ba'i phyir/ nyin mtshan gang rung chos can/ khyod ring thung du 'gyur ba'i tshad yod de/ zhag re la thang cig res 'phel 'grib kyi ring thung du 'gyur ba'i phyir/ thang cig gi tshad yod de/ zhag gcig gi cha dgu brgyad byas pa'i cha gcig la byed pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ ring thung du 'gyur ba'i dus yod de/ lho bgrod kyi tshe thung*/ byang bgrod kyi tshe ring bar 'gyur ba'i phyir te/ nyi ma byang bgrod kyi tshe mthor song ba'i dbang gis 'char snga la/ nub pa phyi bas nyin mo ring la mtshan mo thung zhing*/ zla ba la'ang phyogs 'dra ba'i phyir/ nyi zla gnyis lho byang du bgrod pa res mos yin te/ de gnyis las gcig lho bgrod kyi tshe cig shos byang bgrod yin la/ gcig byang bgrod kyi tshe cig shos lho bgrod byed pa'i phyir/ tshes gsum lta bu la zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ma rdzogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ de'i tshe zla ba nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dang nye ba las nyi 'od zla ba'i gzhal med khang la babs pa na pha rol gyi ngos su zla ba rang gi grib ma babs pa las 'grib par snang bar grags pa'i phyir/

dper na/ mtshan mo ka ba dang mar me'i 'od nye ba na ka ba rang gi grib mas phar ngos sgrib par byed pa bzhin du'o/ /gnyis pa spyi don la/ dus tshigs gang las byung ba dang*/ byed pa po yod med dang*/ dus tshigs so sor bshad pa dang gsum/ dang po ni/ rgyas par bshad na mang yang 'dir bsdus nas bshad par bya ste/ bskal ba dang po'i mi rnams kyi lus kyi 'od sogs nyams nas 'jig rten du mun pa byung ba la brten nas mya ngan byas pas spyi mthun gyi las kyis nyi zla gza' skar sogs byung ste/ de la brten nas nyin mtshan dang dus tshigs kyi rnam gzhag rnams byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa yod de/ de'i tshe nyi zla sogs go rim ma nges par rgyu ba las bdag cag gi ston pa 'di drang srong rnga bong du gyur ba'i dus su rgyu skar sogs kyi go rim mdzad par bshad pas byed pa po yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ spyir dus kyi tha snyad la du ma yod kyang 'chi med mdzod las 'di ltar bshad de/ mig 'dzum bco brgyad mtha' gnas la/ /de sum cu la skad cig bgrang*/ de ni bcu gnyis yud tsam yin/ /de sum cu la nyin zhag gcig /de dag bco lngar phyogs su grags/ /snga phyi'i phyogs ni dkar nag gnyis/ /de gnyis bsdoms pas 'jal byed do/ /mchu zla la sogs gnyis gnyis la/ /de tshigs de gsum bgrod pa gcig /lho byang bkod pa gnyis la lo/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ lo rnam pa gsum yod de/ tshes lo nyin zhag gi lo khyim lo gsum yod pa'i phyir/ de gsum gyi khyad par cung zad rgyas pa zhig gzhan du bshad zin pas 'dir bsdu na de gsum gyi khyad par yod de/ nyi mas khyim bcu gnyis la rang 'gros kyis rdzogs par spyod pa'i tshul gyis bgrod gnyis rdzogs pa'i lo de khyim lo dang*/ nam langs nas nam langs kyi bar nyin zhag gi zla ba bcu gnyis la nyin zhag gi lo dang*/ zla ba'i 'phel 'grib kyi cha re rdzogs pa'i tshes zhag gi zla ba bcu gnyis rdzogs pa la tshes zhag gi lor 'jog pa'i phyir/

gzhan yang lo'i dbye ba yod de/ rab byung la sogs pa'i drug cu yod cing*/ de yang me yos sogs lo rgan drug cu dang don gcig tu 'gyur ba'i phyir/ zla ba dang zhag la'ang de gsum yod de/ lug glang 'khrig pa karka ṭa sogs khyim zla dang khyim zhag /stag gi zla ba la sogs pa'i zla ba bcu bzhi dang*/ mgo la sogs pa'i zla ba bcu gnyis dang zhags sogs kyi tha snyad kyang yod pa'i phyir/ spyir lo 'go ngos 'dzin la mang du yod kyang 'dul mngon gyi lugs la lo 'go 'dzin tshul yod de/ hor zla bcu pa'i mar ngo'i tshes gcig nas 'dzin pa'i phyir/ lo la dus tshigs byed tshul du ma yod de/ gsum dang bzhi dang lnga dang drug rnams su yod pa'i phyir/ dang po yod de/ mgo bo rgyal mchu dbo'i zla ba bzhi ni dgun dang*/ nag pa sa ga snron chu stod kyi zla ba bzhi ni dpyid/ gro bzhin khrums tha skar smin drug gi zla ba bzhi ni dbyar dus su 'jog pa'i phyir/ dus tshigs la bzhir 'jog tshul yod de/ dgun dpyid dbyar ston bzhir byas nas rgyu skar snga ma gsum gsum dang sbyar nas 'jog pa'i phyir/ dus tshigs la lngar 'byed tshul yod de/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar tsam dang dbyar thung du dang dbyar ring po'i dus dang lngar 'jog pa'i phyir te/ dbyar tha chung gi tshes bcu drug la dbyar thung du zhes pa ma gtogs snga ma dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ dus tshigs la drug tu 'byed tshul yod de/ dgun stod dgun smad sogs gnyis gnyis phye bas drug tu 'gyur ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ dus tshigs la dbye ba de ltar mdzad pa la chos can/ dgos pa yod de/ gsum du phye ba ni phyag dar khrod pa'i gos shes pa dang*/ bzhir phye ba ni 'jig rten grags pa dang sgo bstun pa dang*/ lngar phye ba ni dbyar thung ngu shes pa dang*/ drug tu phye ba ni gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa dang zhag mi thub 'byung ba'i dus shes pa'i ched yin pa'i phyir/

phyi ma grub ste/ lo dri ba las/ rgyal dang dbo dang sa ga can/ zhes sogs dang*/ rang 'grel las/ dgun dang dpyid dang dbyar rnams kyi zhes sogs 'byung ba ltar yin pa'i phyir/ zla bshol 'dod tshul la zhib rtsis dang rags rtsis gnyis yod cing dang po ni gzhan du shes par bya dgos la/ rags rtsis la 'don tshul yod de/ tshes zhag las nyin zhag yud tsam phyed kyis ring ba la brten nas zla ba gnyis gnyis na nyin zhag re ma thub pa'i dbang gis lo lnga lnga nas zla bshol 'don pa dang*/ tshes zhag gis khyim zhag gi dod ma thub pa la brten nas khyim lo gnyis dang zla ba phyed dang dgu nas zla bshol 'don pa'i tshul gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ 'di skor gzhan du bshad zin pas de tsam mo/ /gnyis pa mtha' dpyad pa la kha cig /dus bzhi cig car ba yin te/ gling bzhir dgun bzhi dus cig car grub pa sogs yin pa'i phyir zer na/ de mi 'thad par thal/ gling bzhi so sor dus bzhi rim can du 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dzam gling 'di lta bur dbyar rjes su ston/ ston rjes su dgun/ dgun rjes su dpyid 'byung ba mngon sum du grub pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang*/ de mi 'thad par thal/ de ltar na dbyar nyi mthar thug pa'i tshe nyin zhag gcig tu chu tshod drug cu lhag dang*/ dgun nyi mthar thug pa'i tshe nyin zhag gcig la'ang de ltar du 'gyur bar thal ba sogs kyi skyon yod pa'i phyir/ kha cig /gang la ltos kyang tshes zhag de nyin zhag las thung bas khyab par thal/ zhag gsum gyi nang nas tshes zhag thung ba'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ spyi de ltar yin kyang zla ba'i rkang pa'i dbang gis tshes 'phel dus chu tshod re bzhi'i bar du 'byung ba yod cing*/ 'grib dus chu tshod nga bzhi'i bar du 'ong srid pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zla ba'i snga rkang lugs 'byung gi dus su tshes 'phel dus zla ba'i 'phel 'grib bul la/ phyi rkang rim min gyi dus su tshes 'grib pa na zla ba'i 'phel 'grib mgyogs pas tshes yun thung bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

der thal/ tshes 'phel dus lhag pa bsdud ma dang*/ tshes 'grib dus chad pa bstud mar 'byung ba ri mos rtogs pa'i phyir/ de la kho na re/ nyin zhag la'ang ring thung 'byung bar thal/ dam bca' 'thad pa'i phyir na ma khyab/ 'dod mi nus te/ nyin zhag rer chu tshod drug cu rer nges pa'i phyir/ kha cig /zhag gsum 'jog tshul la dka' sla'i khyad par med zer na/ de yod par thal/ nyin zhag 'jog sla zhing*/ de las tshes zhag cung dka' la/ de las khyim zhag 'jog dka' ba'i phyir/ kha cig /lo bshol 'don rigs par thal/ zla bshol 'don rigs pa'i phyir na ma khyab ste/ zla bshol bton zin nas lo bshol logs su 'don rgyu med pa'i phyir/ 'on kyang 'dir dpyad rgyu yod de/ da lta'i brtsi lugs kyis lo drug cu song ba'i tshe khyim lo dbang btsan par song nas/ de'i tshe tshes lo dang nyin zhag gi lo kho na dang sbyar te brtsis na de las lhag 'ongs srid pa'i phyir dpyad par bya'o// //lnga pa lha rnams kyi gnas bshad pa la/ sa dang 'brel ba'i gnas dang*/ sa 'brel ba'i gnas/ sems can gyi khyad chos/ gong 'og gi bar gyi thag tshad dang bzhi/ dang po la/ rgyal chen bzhi po dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'di la bang rim bzhi yod de/ /bar gyi thag ni stong phrag bcu/ /stong phrag dag ni bcu drug dang*/ /brgyad dang bzhi dang gnyis 'phags so/ /de la lag na gzhong thogs dang*/ /'phreng thogs dang ni rtag myos dang*/ /rgyal chen bzhi pa'i lha rnams gnas/ /ri ni bdun po dag la yang*/ / zhes byung*/ ri rab kyi chu 'tshams yan chad 'di la chos can/ bang rim bzhi yod de/ de re re'i bar gyi thag ni dpag tshad stong bcu bcu ste khri phrag re re yod pa'i phyir/ bang rim de dag chos can/ ri rab las phyir 'phags tshul bzhi yod de/ bang rim dang po 'og ma ni ri rab las phyir dpag tshad stong phrag bcu drug dang*/ gnyis pa stong phrag brgyad dang*/

gsum pa stong phrag bzhi dang*/ bzhi pa stong phrag gnyis phyir 'phags pa'i phyir/ bang rim de la lha gang gnas pa yod de/ dang po la lag na gzhong thogs dang*/ gnyis pa la 'phreng thogs dang*/ gsum pa la rtag myos dang*/ bzhi pa la rgyal chen bzhi dang de'i 'khor gyi lha rnams gnas pa'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ shar phyogs na yul 'khor srung gnas pa sogs yin pa'i phyir te/ der ma zad gser gyi ri bdun po dag la yang rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams gnas pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lhun po'i rtse na sum cu gsum/ de yi ngos la brgyad khri'o/ /zhes byung*/ lhun po chos can/ khyod kyi rtse na sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i gnas yod de/ brgya byin/ nor lha brgyad/ drag po bcu gcig/nyi ma bcu gnyis/ tha skar gyi bu dang bcas pa'i lha'i gtso bo sum cu rtsa gsum bzhugs pa'i gnas yod pa'i phyir lhun po'i rtse chos can/ khyod kyi rgya tshad yod de/ ngos re rer dpag tshad brgyad khri re yod pa'i phyir te/ ri thams cad kyi chu 'tshams yan dpangs zhing mnyam par mtshungs pa'i phyir/gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la/ gnas dang tshal dang sa gzhi dang shing dang 'dun pa dang lnga/ dang po ni/ phyogs 'tshams brtsegs pa bzhi la ni/ /lag na rdo rje'i gnas dbus na/ /grong khyer lta na sdug ces pa/ /ngos la nyis stong lnga brgya ba/ /dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis gser gyi/ /rang bzhin gzhi bkra mnyen pa yod/ /des na rnam par rgyal byed de/ /ngos la nyis brgya lnga bcu'o/ /zhes byung*/ lhun po chos can/ khyod kyi phyogs kyi 'tshams te grwa bzhin khang pa brtsegs pa bzhi yod cig der gang gnas pa yod de/ lha rnams srungs ba po'i gnod sbyin lag na rdo rje gnas pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod kyi rtse'i dbus na gnas yod de/ brgya byin gyi grong khyer lta na sdug ces bya ba yod ba'i phyir/

grong khyer de chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ ngos rer dpag tshad nyis stong lnga brgya dang*/ 'phang du dpag tshad phyed dang gnyis yod pa'i phyir/ de chos can/ rgyu gang las grub pa yod de/ gser gyi rang bzhin las grub cing*/ sa gzhi tshon sna tshogs kyis bkra bar byas pa/ rkang pa bzhag na nem nem dang*/ btegs na par ces byed pa'i 'jam zhing mnyen pa dang ldan pa'i phyir/ grong khyer de chos can/ khyod kyi dbus na brgya byin gyi khang bzang rnam par rgyal byed yod de/ de'i ngos re rer dpag tshad nyis brgya lnga bcu dang*/ mtha' skor du dpag tshad stong dang*/ lta na sdug las kyang gyen du dpag tshad phyed dang lnga 'phags pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi rol sna tshogs shing rta dang*/ /rtsub 'gyur 'dres tshal dga' bas brgyan/ /zhes byung*/ grong khyer lta na sdug chos can/ khyod kyi phyogs bzhir lha'i tshal bzhi yang de/ shar du shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal dang*/ lho na shes rgyud rtsub par 'gyur ba'i tshal dang*/ nub na lha'i pho mo 'dres shing rtse ba'i tshal dang*/ byang na yid dga' bar byed pa'i tshal rnams kyis brgyan nas yod pa'i phyir/ shing rta sna tshogs kyi tshal de chos can/ khyod du glang chen sa srung yod cing de'i tshad dang 'phrul yod de/ lus dkar zhing mgo dmar ba mche ba drug ldan/ srid du dpag tshad gcig dang khor yug bdun yod pa 'khor glang pau che brgya stong dang ldan pa/ mgo so gsum sprul te mgo gtso bo la dbang po dang gzhan so gnyis la nye dbang so gnyis zhon nas 'gro ba sogs kyi 'phrul du ma dang ldan pa'i phyir/ gsum pa sogs ni/ de dag gi ni phyogs bzhi na/ /nyi shus bcad na sa gzhi bzang*/ /byang shar 'tshams na yongs 'du ste/ /lho nub 'tshams na chos bzang ngo*/ /zhes byung*/ skyes tshal de dag chos can/ khyod kyi phyogs bzhi na gnas bzhi yod de/ dpag tshad nyi shus bcad pa na sa gzhi bzang po tshal rnams la 'gran nus pa bzhi yod pa'i phyir/

bzhi pa ni/ lta na sdug chos can/ khyod kyi byang shar na shing khyad par can yod de/ rtsa ba dpag tshad lnga brgya thur du zug cing de tsam gyen du 'phags pa'i yongs 'du sa brtol zhes bya ba yal 'dab me tog 'bras bu dri phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan pa yod pa'i phyir ro/ /lnga pa ni/ de chos can/ khyod kyi phyi rol lho nub 'tshams na chos bzang lha'i 'dun sa yod de/ de'i mchu zhing la dpag tshad sum brgya dang gyen du khyod las 'phags shing*/ nang du brgya byin gyi gser khri dang*/ nye dbang rnams kyi khri dang bcas pa yod pa'i phyir/ dbang po dang nye dbang rnams kyi mdzad pa yod de/ tshes brgyad dang bco lnga'i dus su rgyal chen bzhi dang bcas rnams 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can gyis chos dang chos min gang byed lta nyul mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir ro// 7 gnyis pa sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas ni/ de steng lha rnams gzhal med khang*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas yod de/ sum cu rtsa gsum gyi steng na 'thab bral sogs 'dod lha drug dang*/ tshangs chen sogs gzugs khams kyi gnas bcu bdun rnams yod pa'i phyir/ gnas de dag gang la brten pa yod de/ rlung dang sprin gyi phung po ci rigs la brten pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa sems can gyi khyad chos la/ 'dod pa la spyod tshul dang*/ lha'i skye tshul dang*/ bde ba'i khyad par gsum/ dang po ni/ 'dod pa spyod pa drug yin no/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud dang lag bcangs dang*/ /dgod dang bltas pas 'khrig pa yin/ zhes byung*/ gong ma gnyis kyis 'dod pa mi spyod cing 'dod pa'i lha drug chos can/ khyod kyis 'dod pa la spyod tshul yod de/ khyod la sa rim pa bzhin sum cu rtsa gsum dang rgyal chen bzhi'i lha gnyis ni mi ltar dbang po gnyis sprad nas 'dod pa spyod cing*/ 'thab bral bas 'khyud pa tsam dang*/ dga' ldan pas lag pa bcangs pa tsam dang*/ 'phrul dga' bas dgod pa tsam dang*/

gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pas bltas pa tsam gyis 'khrig pa'i bde ba la spyod par byed pa'i phyir/ 'og ma gnyis mi ltar dbang po gnyis sprad kyang khyad par yod de/ de rnams la rtsa rgyus rgyu ma sogs med pas dbang po'i sgo nas rlung nyi tshe 'byung gi khu khrag 'byung ba med pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ byis pa lo lnga lon pa nas/ lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar/ de dag tu skye gzugs can rnams/ /kun rdzogs gos dang bcas pa nyid/ /ces byung*/ 'dod pa'i lha las bu skye tshul yod de/ lha pho mo gang gi pang par bu'am bu mo gang brdzus te byung ba de de'i bu dang bu mor 'jog pa'i phyir te/ tshad ni rgyal chen bzhi pa la da lta'i byis pa la lo lnga lta bu nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa la byes pa lo bcu lon pa lta bu'i bar 'dod lha de dag tu skye ba'i phyir/ gzugs khams sam gzugs can gyi lha rnams chos can/ chung rim gyis skye ba ma yin te/ skyes ma thag nas lus rdzogs shing gos dang bcas pa nyid du skye ba'i phyir/ 'dod lha'i nang nas kyang brgya byin yang rdzogs par skye bas skye ba brjes pa lha gzhan gyis mi shes par gsungs te/ dmigs bsal yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ 'dod pa skye ba gsum pa ni/ /'dod pa'i lha dang mir bcas rnams/ /bde ba skye ba gsum pa ni/ /bsam gtan gsum las sa bdag yin/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod pa skye ba gsum yod de/ 'dod pa'i lha dang mir bcas pa rnams la 'jog pa'i phyir te/ mi dang 'dod lha 'og ma bzhi ni yul ji ltar byung ba la 'dod pa spyod pa dang po yin la/ 'dod lha lnga pa 'phrul dga' ba ni rang gis 'dod pa sprul pa la spyod pa'i 'dod pa skye ba gnyis pa dang*/ gzhan 'phrul ba ni rang gi 'dod pa bzhin bdag gis sprul pa dang gzhan gyis sprul pa la 'dod pa spyod pa gsum pa yin pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang bde ba skye ba gsum gsungs te/

bsam gtan dang po gsum las sa gsum gsum ste dgur phye bas rim pa bzhin du bsam gtan dang po gsum ni dben pa las skyes pa'i bde ba dang*/ gnyis pa gsum ni ting nge 'dzin las skyes pa'i bde ba dang*/ gsum pa gsum ni dga' ba med pa'i bde ba la spyod par 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /bzhi pa bar thag gi tshad ni/ gnas nas gnas 'og ji srid pa/ /de nas de yi gong de srid/ ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gnas de dag gi bar thag gi tshad yod de/ rgyal chen bzhi'i gnas nas gnas 'og ma 'dzam bu'i gling gi bar la dpag tshad bzhi khri ji srid yod pa de bzhin du/ rgyal chen bzhi nas sum cu rtsa gsum bar dpag tshad bzhi khri dang*/ sum cu rtsa gsum nas 'thab bral bar la brgyad khri/ de nas dga' ldan bar la khri tsho bcu drug /de nas 'phrul dga' bar la so gnyis/ de nas gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bar la re bzhi/ de nas tshangs ris bar khri khrag brgyad dang nyer brgyad yod pa sogs rigs 'gre sbyor rigs pa'i phyir/ mdor na 'di ltar yin te/ gnas de dang de nas 'dzam gling bar la tshad ci tsam yod pa de bzhin du/ de nas de yi gong ma'i gnas kyi bar tshad de srid tsam zhig yod pa'i phyir/ yang rdzu 'phrul gzhan brten ma gtogs pa/ de dag gong ma mthong ba med/ ces gsungs te/ gnas 'og mar skyes pa'i gang zag rang stobs kyis gnas gong ma rnams su bgrod pa dang mthong nus pa med kyang mtha' gcig tu ma nges te/ rdzu 'phrul thob pa dang gzhan gyis de dag tu 'khrid pa lta bu gzhan la brten pa dang gong sa'i ting nge 'dzin thob pa lta bu ma gtogs pa'i dbang du byas pa'i phyir/ /drug pa stong gsum ngos bzung ba ni/ gling bzhi dang ni nyi zla dang*/ /ri rab dang ni 'dod lha dang*/ /tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong la ni/ /stong ni spyi phud yin par 'dod/ /de stong la ni stong gnyis pa/ /bar ma'i 'jig rten khams yin no/ /de stong la ni stong gsum mo/

/mnyam du 'jig cing 'byung ba yin/ / zhes byung*/ stong gsum las dang po stong spyi phud kyi 'jig rten chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ gling bzhi re re la stong dang*/ de bzhin du/ nyi ma dang zla ba dang ri rab dang 'dod lha drug dang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten stong longs pa la ni stong spyi phud dam stong dang po yin par 'dod pa'i phyir/ stong gnyis pa dang gsum pa chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ stong dang po de stong la ni stong gnyis pa bar ma'i 'jig rten gyi khams yin zhing*/ stong gnyis pa de stong la ni stong gsum gyi stong chen por 'jog pa'i phyir/ stong gsum po de chos can/ 'chags 'jig kyang dus mnyam pa yin te/ me chu sogs kyi rkyen gyis dus mnyam du 'jig cing slar 'chags pa 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir/ stong gsum po de re re la'ang lcags ri nag po re res bskor ba kun btus las bshad cing de yang snga ma las phyi ma rim gyis mtho bar gzhan las bshad pa ltar yin te/ de gsum snga ma las phyi ma rgya che ba'i phyir/ stong gsum la ni gcig kho nar ma nges te/ steng 'og dang thad ka'i phyogs phyogs na stong gsum gyi grangs mtha' med pa yod pa'i phyir te/ nam mkha' la ni mtha' med pa'i phyir/ 'di dag ni theg chen thun mong ba ltar na mchog sprul gcig gi zhing yin la/ zhing thams cad 'jog tshul 'di kho na ltar mdzes te/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing dbyibs tshad dang 'byung 'jig sogs sna tshogs pa yod pa'i phyir ro// bdun pa 'gro ba rnams kyi lus dang tshe tshad bshad pa la/ lus tshad dang tshe tshad gnyis/ dang po la/ mi'i lus tshad dang*/ lha'i lus tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa rnams kyi tshad/ khru bzhi pa dang phyed dang bzhi/ /shar dang ba lang spyod dang ni/ /byang zhes bya ba nyis 'gyur bskyed/ /ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gling bzhi'i mi rnams kyi lus tshad yod de/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi'i lus ni kha dog khru bzhi pa dang*/

phal cher ni khru phyed dang bzhi yin la/ shar khru brgyad/ ba lang spyod pa bcu drug /byang sgra mi snyan pa so gnyis zhes bya snga ma las phyi ma nyis 'gyur du bskyed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod lha dang*/ gzugs khams pa'i lus tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ 'dod dang ldan pa'i lha yi lus/ /bzhi cha nas ni rgyang grags dag /phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed/ /ces byung*/ 'dod dang ldan pa'i lha'i lus tshad yod de/ rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa rgyang grags kyi bzhi cha/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa bzhi cha gnyis/ 'thab bral ba bzhi cha gsum/ dga' ldan pa rgyang grags gcig /'phrul dga' ba rgyang grags gcig dang bzhi cha gcig / gzhan 'phrul ba rgyang grags phyed dang gnyis kyi bar du bskyed pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs can dang po dpag tshad phyed/ /de yi gong ma phyed phyaid bskyed/ /'od chung rnams kyi ltag yan chad/ /lus ni nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur te/ /sprin med dpag tshad gsum dor ro/ /zhes byung*/ de chos can/ gzugs khams pa'i lus tshad yod de/ gzugs can dang po tshangs ris pa'i lus dpag tshad phyed dang*/ de yi gong ma bzhi la dpag tshad phyed phyed bskyed pas 'dun na 'don dpag tshad gcig /tshangs chen phyed gnyis/ 'od chung gnyis dang*/ 'od chung gi lha yan chad kyi lus ni snga ma las phyi ma nyis 'gyur byas pas tshad med 'od dpag tshad bzhi/ 'od gsal brgyad/ dge chung ba bcu drug /dge rgyas so gnyis/ sprin med nyis 'gyur las dpag tshad gsum dor bas brgya nyer lnga/ 'bras bu che ba lnga brgya/ mi che ba stong*/ mi gdung ba nyis stong*/ gya nom snang ba bzhi stong*/ shin tu mtho ba brgyad stong*/ 'og min pa'i lus dpag tshad khri drug stong yod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa tshe tshad la/ bde 'gro dang ngan 'gro dang ma nges pa'i 'chi ba yod med gsum/ dang po la mi dang lha'i tshe tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ sgra mi snyan na tshe stong ste/ /gnyis na phyed phyed spangs pa'o/

/'di na ma nges tha mar ni/ /lo bcu dang po dpag tu med/ /ces byung*/ mi dag chos can/ khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/ sgra mi snyan na tshe stong dang*/ nub dang shar gnyis na de'i phyed phyed spangs pa ste nub lnga brgya dang shar na phyed dang sum brgya re yin la/ 'dzam bu'i gling pa'i mi'i tshe ma nges pa'i phyir te/ tha mar tshe lo bcu pa dang bskal ba dang po'i tshe lo ni dpag tu med pa thub pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'dod lha dang gzugs dang gzugs med khams pa'i tshe tshad gsum/ dang po ni/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la/ /'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las/ /'og ma dag gi nyin zhag gcig/des na tshe lo lnga brgya'o/ /gong ma gnyis gnyis 'gyur ro/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'dod lha drug gi tshe tshad yod de/ mi rnams kyi lo lnga bcu la 'dod pa dag gi lha rnams las 'og ma rgyal chen rigs bzhi pa dag gi nyin zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba dang*/ de bcu gnyis lor byas pa des na rang gi tshe lo lnga brgya yin zhing*/ gong ma sum cu rtsa gsum pa yan chad zhag dang lo gnyis gnyis 'gyur du byas nas zla ba lo sngar ltar brtsis na/ mi lo brgya la sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i nyin zhag gcig sogs byas pas rang lo stong*/ de bzhin du nyis brgya/ bzhi brgya/ brgyad brgya/ stong dang drug brgya la rim pa bzhin 'thab bral/ dga' ldan 'phrul dga'/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed pa'i zhag re dang*/ de sum cu la zla bar byas pas rim bzhin rang lo nyis stong*/ bzhi stong*/ brgyad stong*/ khri drug stong thub pa yin pa'i phyir/ gnya' shing 'dzin yan chad na nyi zla'i bya ba la ma ltos kyang nyin zhag gi khyad par 'thad de/ kun+da kha phye nas pad+ma kha zum pa dang bya skad mi 'byin pa sogs kyi tshe mtshan dus su 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gzugs can nyin mtshan med tshe ni/ /rang lus gzhal ba'i bskal pa yis/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs can gyi khams chos can/ khyod du nyin mtshan gyi tha snyad med kyang lha'i tshe tshad yod de/

rang lus gzhal ba'i dpag tshad grangs kyis bar bskal min pa'i bskal par bgrangs pas brtsi ba'i phyir/ der thal/ tshangs ris pa'i lus dpag tshad phyed yin pa de bzhin du/ tshe bar bskal bzhi bcu la bskal pa gcig tu byas pa'i bskal pa dang*/ de bzhin du 'dun na 'don bskal chen gcig /tshangs chen pa de bzhi bcu la bskal pa gcig byas pa'i phyed gnyis/ 'od chung yan bskal chen yin pas 'od chung bskal chen gnyis nas 'og min pa bskal chen khri drug stong yod pas lus tshad ltar yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ gzugs med bskal pa stong phrag ni/ /nyi shu lhag pas lhag pa yin/ /'od chung nas bzung bskal chen te/ /de yi 'og ma phyed yin no/ /zhes byung*/ gzugs med kyi lha chos can/ khyod rnams kyi tshe tshad yod de/ khyod las gzugs med dang po bskal pa stong phrag nyi shu yin la/ de'i gong ma gsum rim par bskal chen nyi shu nyi shu res lhag pas lhag pa yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ rnam shes mtha' yas bzhi khri/ ci yang med drug khri/ srid rtse brgyad khri yin pa'i phyir/ bskal pa de dag chos can/ bar bskal tsam min te/ 'od chung nas bzung srid rtse'i bar bskal chen gyis brtsi la/ gzugs khams de yi 'og ma tshangs ris nas bskal chen de'i phyed la bskal par byas pa'i tshul des rtsi ba'i phyir/ des na tshangs 'dun pa'i tshe tshad ni bskal chen gy-i phyed tsam la 'jog pa'i ni min te/ de phyed dang gnyis la 'jog par bshad pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ngan 'gro'i tshe tshad la/ tsha dmyal/ dud 'gro/ yi dwags/ grang dmyal gyi tshe tshad dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ yang sos la sogs drug rim bzhin/ / 'dod lha'i tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam/ /des na de dag rnams kyi tshe/ /'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin/ /rab tu tsha phyed mnar med ni/ /bar gyi bskal pa'o zhes byung*/ tsha dmyal ba chos can/ khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/ yang sos dang sogs pas thig nag dang bsdus 'joms dang ngu 'bod dang ngu 'bod chen po dang tsha ba drug po de dag rnams kyi tshe tshad dang lo'i brtsi tshul ni rim pa bzhin 'dod lha drug gi tshe dang nyin zhag mnyam pa sogs kyis brtsi ba'i phyir/

der thal/ rgyal chen bzhi pa rang la lnga brgya nas gzhan 'phrul ba khri drug stong la 'jog cing*/ de drug yang sos la sogs pa drug gi zhag re yin la/ tshul des zla ba dang lo yang brtsis pa na/ yang sos pa rang lo lnga brgya/ thig nag pa stong*/ bsdus 'joms pa nyid stong*/ ngu 'bod pa bzhi stong*/ ngu 'bod chen po pa brgyad stong*/ tsha ba rang lo khri drug stong la 'jog pa'i phyir/ des na dmyal ba de dag gi tshe tshad brtsi tshul ni 'dod pa'i lha dang 'dra ba yin te/ rgyu mtshan de'i phyir/ rab tu tsha ba dang mnar med kyi tshe tshad yod de/ rab tu tsha ba'i tshe bar bskal phyed dang*/ mnar med ni bar gyi bskal pa gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir ro/ /gnyis pa ni/ /dud 'gro rnams mchog ring bskal pa'o zhes byung*/ dud 'gro chos can/ khyod rnams kyi tshe tshad yod de/ thung ba rnams ni mtha' gcig tu ma nges shing*/ klu lta bu tshe mchog tu ring ba ni bar gyi bskal pa gcig thub pa yod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ yi dwags rnams/ zla ba nyin zhag gi lnga brgya/ zhes byung*/ yi dwags chos can/ khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/ mi'i zla ba gcig la zhag gcig /de sum cu la zla ba/ de bcu gnyis la lor byas pa'i rang lo lnga brgya thub pa'i phyir/ lha min chos can/ tshe chad yod de/ sum cu rtsa gsum pa ltar thub pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ til sbyangs nang nas lo brgya zhing*/ til gcig phyung bas zad gyur pa/ /chu bur can gyi tshe yin te/ /gzhan gyi tshe ni nyi shur 'gyur/ zhes byung*/ grang dmyal ba chos can/ khyod kyi tshe tshad yod de/ til sbyangs te til gyi bang ba ma ga dha'i bre bo che khal brgyad cu shong ba'i til gyi nang nas lo brgya brgya zhing til gcig re phyung bas zad par gyur pa'i yun tshad dang*/ chu bur can gyi tshe tshad mnyam la/ de'i lhag ma chu bur rdol pa sogs bdun ni snga ma las phyi ma nyi shu nyi shus 'phar zhing ring bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/

grang dmyal du ma zad/ tsha dmyal yang snga ma las phyi ma brgyad 'gyur gyis ring ste/ ri mos 'grub pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ sgra mi snyan ma gtogs par 'chi/ /zhes byung*/ sgra mi snyan pa chos can/ khyod ma gtogs pa zhes brjod pa la dgos pa yod de/ khyod tshe ma rdzogs par mi 'chi la/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi tshe tshad bshad pa ltar ma nges pa'i phyir/ mi la tshe nges pa yod de/ srid pa tha ma'i mi rnams dang*/ 'khor bsgyur sogs kyi tshe nges pa'i phyir ro// 7brgyad pa tshad de gzhal thabs la/ de rtsom byed kyi gzhi dang*/ brtsams pa'i 'jal byed gnyis/ dang po ni/ gzugs ming dus mtha' rdul yig dang*/ skad cig ces byung*/ shes bya chos can/ rtsom byed kyi gzugs dang ming dag dus kyi thung mtha' yod de/ rdul phra rab de gzugs kyi thung mtha' dang*/ yi ge ka dang kha lta bu ming gi thung mtha' dang*/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma de dus kyi thung mtha' yin pa'i phyir/ skad cig ma'i tshad yod de/ rdul phra rab gcig bla 'og bsgyur ba lta bu yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ yul gyi tshad dang*/ dus kyi tshad gnyis/ dang po ni/ phra rab rdul dang ni/ /rdul phran dang ni de bzhin du/ /lcags chu ri bong lug dang glang*/ /nyi zer rdul dang sro ma dang*/ /de las byung dang de bzhin du/ /sor tshigs zhes bya gong bdun bsgyur/ /sor mo nyi shu bzhi la khru/ khru bzhi la ni gzhu gang ngo*/ /de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni/ /rgyang grags ni la dgon par 'dod/ /de brgyad dpag tshad ces bya'o/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ rdul phra rab sogs las rgyang grags dang dpag tshad 'grub tshul yod de/ rtsom byed dang po rdul phra rab dang*/ de bdun bsags pas rdul phran gcig dang*/ de bzhin du lcags rdul dang chu rdul dang ri bong gi rdul dang lug rdul glang rdul dang nyi zer gyi rdul dang sro ma dang de las byung ba shig dang*/ de bzhin du nas dang sor tshigs zhes bya ba rnams rim pa bzhin du gong nas gong du bdun 'gyur bsgyur ba'i sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi la khru gang*/

khru bzhi gzhu 'dom gang*/ gzhu 'dom de dag lnga brgya rnams la ni rgyang grags gcig dang*/ de tsam grong las 'phags pa la dgon par 'dod cing*/ rgyang grags de brgyad longs pa la dpag tshad ces bya bar 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ lo dang bskal pa bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la/ de yi skad cig de dag kyang*/ /drug cu la ni thang gcig go /yud tsam nyin zhag zla gsum ni/ /gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur/ /zhag mi thub dang bcas pa yi/ /zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig /ces byung*/ thang cig chos can/ khyod kyi rtsom gzhi yod de/ dus mtha'i skad cig ma brgya nyi shu la de'i skad cig ma gcig /de'i skad cig ma de dag drug cu'i yun la ni khyod nyid du 'jog pa'i phyir/ yud tsam dang nyin zhag dang zla ba gsum ni chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ snga ma snga ma gong nas gong du sum cur 'gyur ba'i tshul gyis yud tsam nyin zhag zla ba gsum du rim par 'jog pa'i phyir/ lo chos can/ 'jog tshul yod de/ lo re re la zhag mi thub dor ba de rnams dang bcas pa yi zla ba bcu gnyis la lo gcig tu 'jog pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zhag mi thub pa drug yod kyang nyin zhag gi lo brtsi ba'i tshe de drug bsnan nas tshang dgos te/ ma tshang na nyin zhag sum brgya drug cu mi yong bas nyin zhag gi lo mi rdzogs pa'i phyir/ der thal/ zhag gsum so so'i lor 'jog pa la ni rang rang gi zhag po sum brgya drug cu nges par tshang dgos pa'i phyir/ zhag gsum gyi rnam dbye legs par shes pa la zhag lhag dang zla lhag 'don tshul shes dgos te/ de la tshes zhag dang khyim zhag gi bar khyad dang de dang nyin zhag gi bar khyad sogs shes dgos pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan pa dang rgyas par bshad pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ bskal pa rnam pa mang bshad pa/ zhes byung*/ bskal pa chos can/ khyod la rnam pa mang du bshad de/ bar bskal/ 'jig bskal/ stong bskal/

'chags bskal/ gnas bskal/ bskal pa chen po sogs bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ 'jig bskal/ 'chags bskal/ gnas bskal/ stong bskal/ bskal chen dang lnga/ dang po ni/ 'jig pa'i bskal pa dmyal ba yi/ / srid pa med nas snod zad pa/ /zhes byung*/ 'jig bskal chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ mnar med kyi dmyal ba'i srid par gsar skye med pa nas bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi gang 'jig rgyu'i snod de zad pa'i bar la 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chags pa dang po'i rlung nas ni/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'chags bskal chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ mnar med kyi dmyal ba'i srid par gsar skye med pa nas bsam gtan dang po gsum gyi gang 'jig rgyu'i snod de zad pa'i bar la 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ 'chags pa dang po'i rlung nas ni/ /dmyal ba'i srid pa'i bar du'o/ /zhes byung*/ 'chags bskal chos can/ bzhag tu yod de/ 'chags par rtsom pa'i dang po rlung 'jam bu khad kyis ldang ba nas ni dmyal ba'i srid par sems can gcig skyes pa'i bar la 'jog pa'i phyir/ 'di'i rlung nas zhes pa ni bshad pa ltar yin gyi/ 'og gzhi'i rlung dkyil nas 'go rtsom par 'dod pa ni mi 'thad de/ bsam gtan dang po gsum po gang rung 'chags pa'i rlung ldang ba sngon du ma song bar 'og gzhi'i rlung dkyil 'chags pa mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ thog mar sa dang ma 'brel ba'i gnas yas rim gyis chags shing*/ de nas sa dang 'brel ba ni mas rim nas chags pa yin pa'i phyir te/ de yang mes 'jig pa'i rjes su chags pa na thog mar bsam gtan dang po'i gnas tshangs pa'i gzhal med khang chags/ de nas 'dun na 'don dang tshangs ris kyi gnas chags/ de nas rlung 'og tu babs pa las gzhan 'phrul dbang byad nas 'thab bral gyi bar chags/ de nas 'og gi rlung dkyil sogs chags pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang de ltar thog mar chags pa'i rlung ldang ba nas yin te/

'di'i thad kyi rgyal sras ma las/ gang gi tshe nam mkha' la rlung 'jam po 'jam po dag ldang ba de nas bzung ste zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/gsum pa la/ bar gyi khug pa bco brgyad bshad pa/ mtha'i ma thog dang yar 'phel bcu dgu'i mtshams bstan pa/ de rnams gnas bskal du bstan pa lnga/ dang po ni/ bar gyi bskal pa dpag med nas/ /tshe lo bcu pa'i bar du'o/ / zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gnas bskal gyi ya thog dang bar bskal dang po yod de/ tshe lo dpag med 'grib pa'i 'tshams zhig nas tshe lo bcu pa'i bar tshad la der 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas yar skye ma bri ba'i/ /bskal pa gzhan ni bco brgyad dang*/ zhes byung*/ bar gyi khug pa chos can/ khyod la bco brgyad yod de/ tshe lo bcu pa de nas yar brgyad khri'i bar skye zhing 'phel ba dang*/ yang mar bcu pa'i bar bri ba re ni bar bskal re dang bar gyi khug pa rer byas pa'i de 'dra'i khug pa bco brgyad longs pa ni ya thog ring mo las gzhan du 'jog pa'i phyir/gsum pa ni/ yar skye ba ni gcig yin te/ zhes byung*/ mtha'i ma thog ring mo yod de/ khug pa'i rjes su tshe lo bcu pa nas brgyad khri'i bar du yar skye ba ste 'phel ba ni gcig kho na yin la/ mar 'grib pa mi 'byung ba de gnas bskal gyi tha ma ma thog zhes bya bar 'jog cing*/ de brgyad khri nas 'jig bskal gyi 'go rtsom par byed pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ de dag tshe ni brgyad khri'i bar/ zhes byung*/ yar 'phel de dag chos can/ khyod kyi tshad yod de/ tshe lo bcu pa nas brgyad khri'i bar du yar 'phel gyi/ de yan chad du mi 'phel ba'i phyir/ thog mtha' gnyis rkyang pa dang bar ba bco brgyad khug pa yin la yun tshad mi mnyam pa'i skyon med de/ /rkyang pa re re'i yun la'ang khug pa re re'i yun tshad yod pa'i phyir te/ rkyang pa gnyis bul la khug pa myur pa'i phyir/ lnga pa ni/ de ltar 'jig rten chags pa 'di/

bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ gnas bskal yod de/ de ltar 'jig rten chags zin pa 'di bar bskal ya thog dang khug pa bco brgyad dang ma thog dang bcas pa'i bar gyi bskal pa nyi shur gnas pa yin pa'i phyir/ tshe lo dpag med nas gnas bskal gyi 'og 'dzin pa mi 'thad de/ de ni 'chags bskal du 'du ba yin pa'i phyir/ gnas bskal gyi 'go tshe lo brgyad khri'i thog ma nas 'dzin pa sa'i dngos gzhi'i lugs yin kyang mdzod rang 'grel gyi lugs la ni cung ma yin te/ dmyal bar 'dzam gling lta bu'i mi zhig ma skyes bar du gnas bskal gyi 'go mi 'dzin pa'i phyir/ tshe lo dpag med kyi dus su byung ba'i mi'i tshe tshad 'dzin mi nus pa min te/ de dag gi gzugs dang tshe sogs tshangs ris pa dang 'dra ba'i phyir/ der thal/ rtsa bar/ sngar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin/ zhes pa dang*/ rang 'grel las/ bskal pa dang po'i mi rnams ni gzugs na spyod pa bzhin du gyur te zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ chags pa dang ni 'jig pa dang*/ /zhig nas 'dug pa dag mnyam mo/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ de ltar 'jig rten 'chags pa dang gnas pa dang 'jig pa dang zhig nas 'dug pa stong pa'i bskal pa bzhi'i tshad mnyam pa dag yin te/ bzhi po re rer bar bskal nyi shu nyi shu res mnyam pa'i phyir/ lnga pa la/ bskal chen ngos bzung ba dang*/ zhar la sangs rgyas sogs 'byung tshul gnyis/ dang po ni/ de dag brgyad cu la bskal chen/ zhes byung*/ bskal chen chos can/ yod de/ bshad ma thag pa'i bar bskal de dag brgyad cu la ni khyod du 'jog pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa la/ sangs rgyas/ rang rgyal/ 'khor sgyur 'byung tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ de grangs med gsum la sangs rgyas/ 'byung ngo mar ni 'grib pa yi/ /brgya yi bar la de dag 'byung*/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ sangs rgyas 'byung tshul yod de/ bskal chen grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags pa las de 'byung ba'i phyir/

grangs med de ni grangs gtan nas med pa ma yin te/ grangs kyi gnas drug cur bgrang du med pas na grangs med ces bshad pa tsam yin pa'i phyir/ grangs med de chos can/ khyod brtsi tshul yod de/ gcig bcu brgya stong khri 'bum dang*/ sa ya bye ba dung 'phyur rnams/ /rkyang pa'i grangs su shes par bya/ /chen po'i zla dang bcas pa ni/ ther 'bum khrag khrig rab bkram dang*/ /gtam dkrig mi 'khrug khyad phyin dang*/ /pang steng der 'dren mtha' snang dang*/ /rgyu rig 'od mdzes dbang pau dang*/ /legs phyin rtogs 'gro 'byin rdul dang*/ /rgya rtags stobs 'khor brda' shes dang*/ /rnam 'byung stobs mig nyi shu gcig /bar du brgyad ni ma rnyed pas/ rang gi ming gang rung ba gzhug /grangs med bar du bcu 'gyur bsgres/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/ chen po dang bcas pa bcu 'gyur bya tshul yod de/ dung 'phyur bcu la ther 'bum gcig /de bcu la ther 'bum chen po gcig /de bcu la khrag khrig gcig /de bcu la khrag khrig chen po gcig tu 'jog pa sogs yin pa'i phyir/ rang 'grel las stobs mig chen po bcu la grangs med pa zhes bshad kyang spyi 'gro la de'i rjes su tshad med bzhi'i ming can chen po dang bcas pa nas grangs med gcig dang*/ de nas bcu 'gyur du byas te de gnyis dang*/ de gsum du 'jog pa ltar yang rung ste/ bar du brgyad ni ma rnyed pas/ /zhes sogs kyi don du snang ba'i phyir/ der ma zad grangs kyi rnam grangs gzhan yang mang ste/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud dang phal chen nas grangs kyi gnas brgya nyer gsum dang*/ sdod po bkod pa las bzhi bcu dang*/ yang brgya dang lnga bshad pa'i phyir/ de dag ni grangs med gsum las kyang lhag ste/ des grangs med grangs med pa yang brtsi nus pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas de dag chos can/ khyod 'byung ba'i dus yod de/ yar 'phel ba'i tshe sems can skyo shas chung bas mi 'byon la/

mar 'grib pa yi brgyad khri nas brgya yi bar la 'byung ba'i phyir/ phyi ma grub ste/ brgya phyin chad ha cang snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dbang gis mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ rang sangs rgyas rnams gnyis ka la/ /bse ru bskal pa brgya yi rgyus/ /zhes byung*/ rang sangs rgyas rnams chos can/ 'byung ba'i dus yod de/ yar 'phel mar 'grib gnyis ka la 'byung ba'i phyir/ de chos can/ khyod la tshegs spyod bse ru lta bu gnyis yod pa las bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal 'byung ba'i rgyu yod de/ bskal pa brgya yi rgyu tshogs bsags pa las 'byung ba'i phyir/ der thal/ 'dir bse ru lta bu'i rang rgyal slob pa ni rang gi byang chub tu rigs nges par 'dod pa'i phyir/ gsum pa 'khor sgyur 'byung tshul la/ /tshig don dang*/ spyi don gnyis/ dang po la/ 'byung ba'i dus/ dbye ba/ 'khor los sgyur tshul/ sangs rgyas dang 'khor bsgyur gyi mtshan gyi khyad par bzhi/ dang po ni/ 'khor los sgyur ba 'byung ba ni/ stong phrag brgyad cu las mi 'phy-i/ zhes byung*/ 'khor los sgyur ba chos can/ khyod 'byung ba'i dus yod de/ tshe lo dpag med nas brgyad khri'i bar kho nar 'byung gi /de phyin chad snod min pas mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ sgra don yod de/ 'khor lo'i sgo nas skye bo la dbang sgyur bas na de ltar brjod pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ gser dngul zangs lcags 'khor lo can/ /de dag gling gcig gling gnyis dang*/ /gling gsum bzhi la mas rim bzhin/ /lhan cig gnyis min sangs rgyas bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ 'khor sgyur chos can/ khyod la rigs bzhi yod de/ gser gyi 'khor lo yod pas gser gyi 'khor sgyur dang*/ de bzhin du dngul dang zangs dang lcags kyi 'khor lo sgyur ba dang bzhi yod pa'i phyir/ de dag las mas rim bzhin du gser gyi 'khor sgyur gyis gling bzhi dang*/ dngul gyis gling gsum dang*/ zangs kyis gling gnyis dang*/

lcags kyi 'khor sgyur gyis gling gcig la dbang byed ma yin te/ mchog dang nye ba'i mchog dang 'bring dang tha ma yin pa'i phyir/ 'di dag gang las bshad tshul yod de/ gdags pa las bstan cing*/ mdo gzhan dag las kyang bshad pa'i phyir/ 'khor sgyur chos can/ khyod gling gcig la lhan cig gam dus gcig tu gnyis mi 'byung ste/ 'gran zla med pa'i las bsags pa'i gang zag yin pa'i phyir/ dper na/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnyis bstan pa gcig la dus gcig tu mi 'byung ba bzhin no/ /'on kyang*/ zhing gzhan gyi sangs rgyas ni zhing 'dir ston pa'i drung du 'byon pa la nges pa med do/ /gsum pa ni/ phas bsu rang 'gro g.yul bshams dang*/ /mtshon brtsams pas rgyal gnod pa med/ /ces byung*/ 'khor sgyur chos can/ khyod bzhis sa la dbang bsgyur tshul yod de/ gser gyi 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po rang la rgyal phran rnams kyis phas nas bsus te rgyal po byed/ dngul ni rang nyid der 'gro ba ste song nas 'dud cing rgyal po byed/ zangs la ni g.yul bshams pa tsam gyis 'dud/ lcags la ni mtshon 'debs brtsams pa tsam gyis 'dud cing dbang du 'gyur bas gzhan la gnod pa ci yang med pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ thub mtshan yul na gnas pa dang*/ /gsal dang rdzogs pas 'phags pa yin/ /zhes byung*/ 'khor sgyur chos can/ khyod dang thub pa la mtshan bzang yod par mtshungs kyang khyad par yod de/ thub pa sangs rgyas kyi mtshan ni gnas 'grus bar yul na ma 'dres par gnas pa dang*/ 'od gsal zhing cha rdzogs pa sogs kyis khyad par du 'phags la/ khyod kyi mtshan ni de ltar ma yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa spyi don la/ rgyu dang dus dang 'byung tshul dang yon tan gyi khyad par dang dgos pa gang gi ched du 'byung ba dang lnga/ dang po rgyu yod de/ bsod nams kyi mthu chen po byas pa las byung ba'i phyir/ gnyis pa dus yod de/ rdzogs ldan ma gtogs mi 'byung bar bshad zin pa ltar yin pa'i phyir/

gsum pa 'byung tshul yod de/ rgyal po rgyal rigs spyi bo nas dbang bskur ba'i chos bco lnga'i dus gso sbyong la gnas pa na/ gser 'khor can du 'gyur ba la gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong yod pa dpag tshad lnga brgya pa brgya byin gyis ster bar 'gyur ba'i phyir/ bzhi pa yon tan nam phun tshogs kyi khyad par yod de/ rgyal srid rin chen bdun dang*/ nye ba'i rin chen bdun dang*/ yo byad kyi rin chen bdun sogs 'byung ba'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ 'khor lo nor bu sogs bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'di dag gi khyad par rgyas pa ni chos yang dag par sdud pa dang dran pa nyer gzhag dang mngon 'byung sogs las 'byung ba ltar shes par bya ste 'dir mi 'chad do/ /gnyis pa grub ste/ ral gri dang lpags pa dang khang pa dang gos dang nags tshal dang mal cha dang l+h+wam ste bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ de'i byed las kyang gzhan du shes/ gsum pa grub ste/ mu sa la gar pa dang*/ bai ḍūr+ya dang gser dang dngul dang mu tig dang shel dang rdo'i snying po ste bdun 'byung ba'i phy-ir/ lnga pa 'byung ba'i dgos pa yod de/ sems can mang po dge bcu la 'god pa'i ched du 'byung ba'i phyir/ 'khor sgyur du 'gyur ba ni byang sems kho nar ma nges te/ sangs rgyas kyi rigs can lam ma zhugs na'ang der 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir/ mdo las dge rtsa 'di byas na 'khor sgyur du 'gyur gsung pa ni 'khor sgyur dngos gnas par dgongs pa'i nges pa med de/ phal cher stobs kyis 'khor sgyur du 'gyur ba la dgongs shing*/ la la ni der skye ba'i rgyu 'dzin pa tsam la 'god pa'i phyir/ dgu pa snod bcud kyi khyad chos la/ dngos dang*/ 'jig bskal bye brag tu bshad pa gnyis/ dang po la/ bskal pa dang po'i khyad par/ de las 'grub tshul/ mthar ji ltar 'byung tshul dang gsum/ dang po ni/ sngar byung sems can gzugs can bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ sngar bskal pa dang por byung ba'i sems can mi rnams chos can/

gzugs can gyi lha bzhin te/ gzugs mdzes pa/ yan lag dang nying lag tshang ba/ rang la 'od yod pa/ dga' ba zas su za ba/ tshe dpag med thub par mdo las bshad pa bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas rim gyis ro la chags/ /le los gsog 'jog byas nas ni/ /'dzin bcas rnams kyis zhing dpon stabs/ /de nas las kyi lam lhag pas/ /tshe thung lo ni bcu yin no/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ de nas rim gyis 'grib tshul yod de/ bskal pa dang po'i mi gzugs kyi lha 'dra ba de dag gis sa'i zhag dang ro sbrang rtsi'i ro lta bu byung ba sogs myangs pas ro la chags shing*/ le los gsog 'jog byas nas bdag tu 'dzin pa dang bcas pa rnams kyis zhing btab ste longs spyod kyi ched du 'thab rtsod byung nas dpon du mang pos bkur ba'i rgyal po bskos/ de la kun gyis zhing gi drug cha bstabs par byas pas rgyal rigs kyi thog ma byung ba'i phyir/ de nas rigs lhag ma rnams dang las lam byung tshul yod de/ de'i tshe khyim las phyol nas nags khrod sogs su rtsa ba dang 'bras bu za zhing tshangs par spyad pa rnams la bram ze dang*/ khyim du gnas kyang rku sogs mi byed pa'i 'byor can la rje rigs dang so nom dang rku dang srog gcod sogs byed pa la dmangs rigs dang gdol ba'i rigs zhes pa'i tha snyad byung zhing*/ de nas rdzun dang srog gcod sogs mi dge ba'i las kyi lam lhag pa ste 'phel bas/ rim gyis tshe bri nas lo ni thung ba bcu pa'i bar du yang 'byung ba yin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsum pa ni/ bskal pa mtshon dang nad dang ni/ /mu ge dag gis tshar phyin to/ /zhag rnams dang ni zla ba dang*/ /lo bdun dag tu go rim bzhin/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ mthar ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul yod de/ bcud kyi sems can ni mtshon dang nad dang mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma gsum po dag gis tshar phyin pa ste rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir/

de gsum gyi yun tshad yod de/ go rim bzhin du mtshon gyi bskal pa zhag bdun rnams dang*/ de'i sngon du nad kyi bskal pa zhag bdun zla ba bdun dang*/ de'i sngon du mu ge'i bskal pa lo bdun zla ba bdun zhag bdun 'byung ba'i phyir/ de dag tu mi skye ba'i thabs yod de/ nyi ma 'ga' zhig tu srog gcod spong ba'i sdom pa bsrungs pas mtshon bskal dang*/ dge 'dun la a ru ra sogs sman phul bas nad bskal dang*/ dge 'dun la bsod snyoms phul bas mu ge'i bskal bar mi skye bar bshad pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa 'jig bskal bye brag tu bshad pa la/ 'jig rkyen/ 'jig bya/ 'jig pa'i rgyu mtshan/ sngi ltar 'jig tshul dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ me dang chu dang rlung dag gis/ /'jig pa dag ni yang gsum yin/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ snod 'jig rkyen la gsum yod de/ da lta'i nyi ma 'di dang nyi ma gzhan drug rim gyis byung nas me dang char chen po 'bab pa'i chu dang*/ drag po'i rlung dag gis 'jig pa dag ni gsum yin pa'i phyir/ yang zhes smos pa la dgos pa yod de/ mu stegs pas rdul phra rab mi 'jig par 'dod kyang 'dir de yang 'jig par ston pa'i phyir/ gnyis pa ni/ bsam gtan gnyis sogs gsum po ni/ /de dag gi tshe go rim bzhin/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ 'jig pa gsum gyi 'jig bya dang gang lus pa yod de/ bsam gtan gnyis pa dang*/ sogs kyi sa gsum pa dang bzhi pa gsum gyi 'og man chad me chu rlung gsum gyis 'jig par byed cing*/ de dag gi rtse mo ste gong ma gsum de'i tshe yi 'jig pa'i phyir/ der thal/ mes bsam gtan dang po man chad dang*/ chus bsam gtan gnyis pa man chad dang*/ rlung gis rang gi 'jig bya bsam gtan gsum pa man chad 'jig cing*/ rang rang gi gong ma lus pa gnyis pa dang gsum pa dang bzhi pa rnams mi 'jig pa'i tshul go rim bzhin du sbyor ba yin pa'i phyir/ gsum pa ni/ de yi skyon dang chos mthun phy-ir/

/bzhi pa na med mi g.yo'i phyir/ /mi rtag de yi gzhal med khang*/ /sems can bcas te 'byung 'jig phyir/ /zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ de ltar 'jig pa'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ 'jig byed me chu rlung gsum dang mthun pa'i skyon gsum gyi dbang gis yin pa'i phyir/ der thal/ sems can de dang de'i nang gi skyon bsam gtan dang po na rtog dpyod me lta bu dang*/ gnyis pa na bsam gtan gyi skyon dga' bde chu lta bu dang*/ gsum pa na de'i skyon dbugs 'byung rngub kyi rlung yod pas na phy-i rkyen de gsum gyi dbang gis 'jig par byed pa'i phyir/ dang po grub ste/ rtog dpyod kyis yid me ltar gdung bar byed pa'i phy-ir/ gnyis pa grub ste/ shin sbyangs kyi dga' ba des lus mnyen cing chu ltar rlan par byed pa'i phy-ir/ gsum pa grub ste/ dbugs kyi 'byung rngub rlung ltar byed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan bzhi pa na 'jig pa de gsum med de/ /bsam gtan bzhi pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ skyon de dag gis mi g.yo ba'i phyir/ 'o na de dag rtag pa yin nam zhe na/ mi rtag pa yin te/ bzhi pa de'i gzhal med khang sems can dang bcas te lhan cig 'byung ba dang lhan cig 'jig par byed pa'i phyir/ der thal/ de dag gi snod rnams skar ma ltar ma 'brel bar so sor gnas pas so so las thun mong du 'jig pa med pa'i phyir/ bzhi pa ni/ me yis bdun no chu yis gcig /de ltar chu bdun thal nas kyang*/ /me yis bdun no de nas ni/ /mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa yin/ zhes byung*/ shes bya chos can/ de nas 'jig byed gsum gyis 'jig tshul yod de/ me yis 'jig pa'i tshul bdun 'byung zhing*/ de nas chu yis 'jig pa gcig 'byung*/ tshul de ltar mes 'jig bdun re'i mjug tu chus 'jig re re 'byung zhing chus 'jig bdun thal nas ni/ de'i rjes su me yis 'jig pa bdun dang*/ de nas ni mjug tu rlung gis 'jig pa gcig 'byung ba yin pa'i phy-ir/

mes 'jig gi tshe nyi ma gcig po 'di bdun 'gyur gyi tsha bar song nas 'jig pa dang*/ nyi ma gzhan drug logs su 'byung bar 'dod pa'i tshul gnyis snang ba las phyi ma ltar mngon no/ /mes 'jig mang zhing de las chus 'jig nyung ba dang rlung gis 'jig pa gcig 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan yod de/ tshangs chen dang 'od gsal dang dge rgyas pa'i tshe tshad kyi khyad par gyis yin pa'i phyir/ de ltar na bskal chen de bzhin rlung 'jig 'byung ba yin te/ mes 'jig bdun tshan brgyad dang*/ chus 'jig bdun tshan gcig /de nas rlung gis 'jig pa gcig 'byung ba'i phyir ro/ / gnas gsum pa'i tshig don legs par bshad zin to// //dge'o//
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/chos mngon pa mdzod kyi gnas gsum pa'i rnam bshad bzhugs/ -PAGE 196--PAGE 195--PAGE 133-
